tasks.examiner: أَهْلًا وَسَهْلًا! مَا اسْمُكَ، وَكَمْ عُمْرُكَ؟
tasks.task: Say your name and your age.
tasks.model: اسْمِي آدَمُ، وَعُمْرِي أَرْبَعَ عَشْرَةَ سَنَةً.
tasks.en: My name is Adam and I am fourteen.

tasks.task: Say what time you usually wake up.
tasks.model: أَسْتَيْقِظُ عَادَةً فِي السَّاعَةِ السَّادِسَةِ وَالنِّصْفِ.
tasks.en: I usually wake up at half past six.

tasks.task: Say what you have for breakfast.
tasks.model: أَتَنَاوَلُ الخُبْزَ وَالجُبْنَ، وَأَشْرَبُ الحَلِيبَ.
tasks.en: I eat bread and cheese, and I drink milk.

tasks.task: Say how you get to school.
tasks.model: أَسْتَقِلُّ الحَافِلَةَ، وَأَصِلُ إِلَى المَدْرَسَةِ فِي الثَّامِنَةِ.
tasks.en: I take the bus and arrive at school at eight.

tasks.task: Answer the unexpected question.
tasks.model: بَعْدَ المَدْرَسَةِ أَتَنَاوَلُ الغَدَاءَ، ثُمَّ أَدْرُسُ.
tasks.en: After school I have lunch, then I study.

roleplays.setting: A phone call with your host family
roleplays.title: Calling your host family
roleplays.you: a student going on an exchange visit

tasks.task: Say when you wake up on school days.
tasks.model: فِي أَيَّامِ المَدْرَسَةِ أَسْتَيْقِظُ مُبَكِّرًا، فِي السَّاعَةِ السَّادِسَةِ.
tasks.en: On school days I wake up early, at six o’clock.

tasks.task: Say when you wake up at the weekend — and why.
tasks.model: فِي نِهَايَةِ الأُسْبُوعِ أَسْتَيْقِظُ مُتَأَخِّرًا، لِأَنِّي أُحِبُّ النَّوْمَ!
tasks.en: At the weekend I wake up late, because I love sleeping!

tasks.examiner: مَاذَا تَفْعَلُ فِي الصَّبَاحِ قَبْلَ المَدْرَسَةِ؟
tasks.task: Give two or three morning activities in order.
tasks.model: أَوَّلًا أَغْتَسِلُ، ثُمَّ أَرْتَدِي مَلَابِسِي، وَبَعْدَ ذٰلِكَ أَتَنَاوَلُ الإِفْطَارَ.
tasks.en: First I shower, then I get dressed, and after that I have breakfast.

tasks.task: ASK what time the family has breakfast (the examiner then answers).
tasks.model: فِي أَيِّ سَاعَةٍ تَتَنَاوَلُونَ الإِفْطَارَ؟
tasks.en: What time do you (all) have breakfast?

tasks.examiner: هَلْ تَحْتَاجُ إِلَى شَيْءٍ فِي الصَّبَاحِ؟
tasks.task: Answer the unexpected question.
tasks.model: نَعَمْ، أَحْتَاجُ إِلَى مُنَبِّهٍ، لِأَنِّي أَكُونُ نَاعِسًا فِي الصَّبَاحِ.
tasks.en: Yes, I need an alarm clock, because I am sleepy in the morning.

roleplays.title: Joining the swimming club
roleplays.you: a student who wants to join a club

tasks.examiner: أَهْلًا بِكَ فِي النَّادِي. كَيْفَ أُسَاعِدُكَ؟
tasks.task: Say which class you want to join.
tasks.model: أُرِيدُ أَنْ أَشْتَرِكَ فِي دَرْسِ السِّبَاحَةِ، مِنْ فَضْلِكَ.
tasks.en: I would like to join the swimming class, please.

tasks.examiner: عِنْدَنَا دُرُوسٌ صَبَاحًا وَمَسَاءً. أَيُّ وَقْتٍ يُنَاسِبُكَ؟
tasks.task: Choose a time and give a reason.
tasks.model: يُنَاسِبُنِي المَسَاءُ، لِأَنِّي فِي المَدْرَسَةِ مِنَ الثَّامِنَةِ إِلَى الثَّالِثَةِ.
tasks.en: The evening suits me, because I am at school from eight to three.

tasks.task: Describe your afternoon in order (three activities).
tasks.model: أَصِلُ إِلَى البَيْتِ فِي الرَّابِعَةِ، ثُمَّ أَتَنَاوَلُ الغَدَاءَ وَأُنْهِي وَاجِبَاتِي، وَأَخِيرًا أَرْتَاحُ قَلِيلًا.
tasks.en: I get home at four, then I have lunch and finish my homework, and finally I rest a little.

tasks.task: ASK how long the lesson lasts (the examiner then answers).
tasks.model: كَمْ دَقِيقَةً يَسْتَغْرِقُ الدَّرْسُ؟
tasks.en: How many minutes does the lesson last?

tasks.examiner: كَمْ مَرَّةً تُمَارِسُ الرِّيَاضَةَ فِي الأُسْبُوعِ؟
tasks.task: Answer the unexpected question.
tasks.model: أُمَارِسُ الرِّيَاضَةَ مَرَّتَيْنِ فِي الأُسْبُوعِ عَادَةً، وَأَحْيَانًا ثَلَاثَ مَرَّاتٍ.
tasks.en: I usually do sport twice a week, and sometimes three times.

roleplays.setting: An interview for the school radio
roleplays.title: The school radio: a balanced day

tasks.examiner: صِفْ لَنَا يَوْمًا عَادِيًّا فِي حَيَاتِكَ.
tasks.task: Describe a typical day, with times and sequence.
tasks.model: أَسْتَيْقِظُ فِي السَّادِسَةِ، وَبَعْدَ أَنْ أَتَوَضَّأَ وَأُصَلِّيَ الفَجْرَ أَسْتَعِدُّ لِلْمَدْرَسَةِ، ثُمَّ أَخْرُجُ مِنَ البَيْتِ فِي السَّابِعَةِ وَالنِّصْفِ.
tasks.en: I wake up at six; after I do wudu and pray Fajr I get ready for school, then I leave home at half past seven.

tasks.examiner: مَا الفَرْقُ بَيْنَ أَيَّامِ الدِّرَاسَةِ وَالعُطْلَةِ؟
tasks.task: Compare school days and holidays.
tasks.model: فِي أَيَّامِ الدِّرَاسَةِ يَكُونُ يَوْمِي مُنَظَّمًا وَسَرِيعًا، أَمَّا فِي العُطْلَةِ فَأَسْتَيْقِظُ مُتَأَخِّرًا وَأَقْضِي وَقْتًا أَطْوَلَ مَعَ أُسْرَتِي.
tasks.en: On school days my day is organised and fast; in the holidays I wake up late and spend longer with my family.

tasks.task: Say what you did yesterday (past tense).
tasks.model: أَمْسِ رَجَعْتُ إِلَى البَيْتِ مُتْعَبًا، فَأَخَذْتُ قَيْلُولَةً قَصِيرَةً، ثُمَّ رَاجَعْتُ دُرُوسِي سَاعَتَيْنِ.
tasks.en: Yesterday I came home tired, so I had a short nap, then I revised for two hours.

tasks.examiner: هَلْ رُوتِينُكَ صِحِّيٌّ فِي رَأْيِكَ؟ لِمَاذَا؟
tasks.task: Give an opinion with a reason and a “but”.
tasks.model: أَعْتَقِدُ أَنَّهُ صِحِّيٌّ إِلَى حَدٍّ مَا، لِأَنِّي أَتَنَاوَلُ الإِفْطَارَ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ، لٰكِنَّنِي أَنَامُ مُتَأَخِّرًا أَحْيَانًا.
tasks.en: I think it is fairly healthy, because I eat breakfast every day, but I sometimes go to bed late.

tasks.examiner: مَاذَا سَتُغَيِّرُ فِي رُوتِينِكَ فِي المُسْتَقْبَلِ؟
tasks.task: Answer the unexpected question (future).
tasks.model: سَأُحَاوِلُ أَنْ أَنَامَ مُبَكِّرًا، وَسَأَسْتَعْمِلُ هَاتِفِي أَقَلَّ فِي اللَّيْلِ.
tasks.en: I will try to sleep early, and I will use my phone less at night.

conversation.qen: What time do you wake up?
conversation.model: أَسْتَيْقِظُ فِي السَّاعَةِ السَّادِسَةِ وَالنِّصْفِ.
conversation.en: I wake up at half past six.

conversation.qen: What do you have for breakfast?
conversation.model: أَتَنَاوَلُ البَيْضَ وَالخُبْزَ عَادَةً.
conversation.en: I usually have eggs and bread.

conversation.qen: How do you go to school?
conversation.model: أَذْهَبُ إِلَى المَدْرَسَةِ بِالسَّيَّارَةِ مَعَ أَبِي.
conversation.en: I go to school by car with my father.

conversation.qen: What do you do in the evening?
conversation.model: فِي المَسَاءِ أَدْرُسُ ثُمَّ أُشَاهِدُ التِّلْفَازَ.
conversation.en: In the evening I study, then I watch TV.

conversation.qen: When do you go to sleep?
conversation.model: أَنَامُ فِي السَّاعَةِ العَاشِرَةِ.
conversation.en: I go to sleep at ten o’clock.

conversation.qen: Describe your morning routine in order.
conversation.model: أَوَّلًا أَسْتَيْقِظُ فِي السَّادِسَةِ، ثُمَّ أُنَظِّفُ أَسْنَانِي وَأَرْتَدِي مَلَابِسِي، وَأَخِيرًا أَتَنَاوَلُ الإِفْطَارَ مَعَ أُسْرَتِي.
conversation.en: First I wake up at six, then I brush my teeth and get dressed, and finally I have breakfast with my family.

conversation.q: هَلْ يَخْتَلِفُ يَوْمُكَ فِي نِهَايَةِ الأُسْبُوعِ؟
conversation.qen: Is your day different at the weekend?
conversation.model: نَعَمْ، فِي نِهَايَةِ الأُسْبُوعِ أَسْتَيْقِظُ مُتَأَخِّرًا، وَأَلْعَبُ كُرَةَ القَدَمِ مَعَ أَصْدِقَائِي.
conversation.en: Yes, at the weekend I wake up late and play football with my friends.

conversation.qen: Who wakes up first in your house?
conversation.model: تَسْتَيْقِظُ أُمِّي أَوَّلًا، لِأَنَّهَا تُحَضِّرُ الإِفْطَارَ لَنَا.
conversation.en: My mother wakes up first, because she prepares breakfast for us.

conversation.q: مَا الجُزْءُ المُفَضَّلُ مِنْ يَوْمِكَ؟ لِمَاذَا؟
conversation.qen: What is your favourite part of the day? Why?
conversation.model: أُحِبُّ المَسَاءَ كَثِيرًا، لِأَنَّنِي أَرْتَاحُ وَأَقْرَأُ كِتَابًا.
conversation.en: I really like the evening, because I relax and read a book.

conversation.qen: What did you do yesterday morning?
conversation.model: أَمْسِ اسْتَيْقَظْتُ مُتَأَخِّرًا، فَخَرَجْتُ مِنَ البَيْتِ بِسُرْعَةٍ.
conversation.en: Yesterday I woke up late, so I left the house quickly.

conversation.q: قَارِنْ بَيْنَ رُوتِينِكَ وَرُوتِينِ شَخْصٍ آخَرَ فِي أُسْرَتِكَ.
conversation.qen: Compare your routine with another family member’s.
conversation.model: بَيْنَمَا أَسْتَيْقِظُ فِي السَّادِسَةِ، يَسْتَيْقِظُ أَخِي الكَبِيرُ فِي الخَامِسَةِ، لِأَنَّهُ يَعْمَلُ فِي مُسْتَشْفًى بَعِيدٍ.
conversation.en: While I wake up at six, my older brother wakes up at five, because he works in a hospital far away.

conversation.q: هَلْ يَنَامُ الطُّلَّابُ وَقْتًا كَافِيًا فِي رَأْيِكَ؟
conversation.qen: Do students get enough sleep, in your opinion?
conversation.model: فِي رَأْيِي لَا يَنَامُ كَثِيرٌ مِنَ الطُّلَّابِ وَقْتًا كَافِيًا، لِأَنَّهُمْ يَسْتَعْمِلُونَ الهَاتِفَ حَتَّى وَقْتٍ مُتَأَخِّرٍ.
conversation.en: In my opinion many students do not get enough sleep, because they use their phones until late.

conversation.q: كَيْفَ تُنَظِّمُ وَقْتَكَ فِي أَيَّامِ الامْتِحَانَاتِ؟
conversation.qen: How do you organise your time during exams?
conversation.model: أَضَعُ جَدْوَلًا لِلْمُرَاجَعَةِ، وَأَدْرُسُ سَاعَةً ثُمَّ أَرْتَاحُ عَشْرَ دَقَائِقَ، وَأَحْرِصُ عَلَى النَّوْمِ مُبَكِّرًا.
conversation.en: I make a revision timetable, study for an hour then rest for ten minutes, and make sure I sleep early.

conversation.q: كَيْفَ كَانَ رُوتِينُكَ عِنْدَمَا كُنْتَ صَغِيرًا؟
conversation.qen: What was your routine like when you were little?
conversation.model: عِنْدَمَا كُنْتُ صَغِيرًا كُنْتُ أَنَامُ مُبَكِّرًا جِدًّا، وَكَانَتْ أُمِّي تُوقِظُنِي كُلَّ صَبَاحٍ.
conversation.en: When I was little I used to sleep very early, and my mother used to wake me every morning.

conversation.q: لَوْ كَانَ عِنْدَكَ يَوْمٌ حُرٌّ تَمَامًا، كَيْفَ تَقْضِيهِ؟
conversation.qen: If you had a completely free day, how would you spend it?
conversation.starter: لَوْ كَانَ عِنْدِي يَوْمٌ حُرٌّ، لَزُرْتُ …
conversation.model: لَوْ كَانَ عِنْدِي يَوْمٌ حُرٌّ، لَزُرْتُ جَدَّتِي فِي الصَّبَاحِ، وَلَلَعِبْتُ مَعَ أَصْدِقَائِي فِي المَسَاءِ.
conversation.en: If I had a free day, I would visit my grandmother in the morning and play with my friends in the evening.

lessons.title: Time and Daily Routine
lessons.intro: Paper 3 practice in breakout rooms: four role plays and a topic conversation about your day — answer every task in a full sentence, then develop with times, sequence, frequency and reasons.

roleplays.title: Booking a lesson
roleplays.you: a student booking a tennis lesson

tasks.task: Say your full name.
tasks.model: اسْمِي يُوسُفُ عَلِيٌّ.
tasks.en: My name is Yusuf Ali.

tasks.task: Say which day you want the lesson.
tasks.model: أُرِيدُ الدَّرْسَ يَوْمَ السَّبْتِ، مِنْ فَضْلِكَ.
tasks.en: I would like the lesson on Saturday, please.

tasks.task: Say what time.
tasks.model: فِي السَّاعَةِ العَاشِرَةِ صَبَاحًا.
tasks.en: At ten o’clock in the morning.

tasks.task: Give your date of birth.
tasks.model: تَارِيخُ مِيلَادِي هُوَ الخَامِسُ مِنْ مَايُو.
tasks.en: My date of birth is the fifth of May.

tasks.task: Answer the unexpected question.
tasks.model: نَعَمْ، يُنَاسِبُنِي الأُسْبُوعُ القَادِمُ، شُكْرًا.
tasks.en: Yes, next week suits me, thank you.

roleplays.setting: A phone call with a friend
roleplays.title: Planning a birthday party

tasks.task: Say the date of your birthday.
tasks.model: عِيدُ مِيلَادِي فِي العَاشِرِ مِنْ نُوفَمْبَرَ.
tasks.en: My birthday is on the tenth of November.

tasks.task: Say which day the party is.
tasks.model: الحَفْلَةُ يَوْمَ الجُمُعَةِ بَعْدَ المَدْرَسَةِ.
tasks.en: The party is on Friday after school.

tasks.task: Say when it starts and finishes.
tasks.model: تَبْدَأُ فِي السَّاعَةِ الرَّابِعَةِ، وَتَنْتَهِي فِي السَّابِعَةِ.
tasks.en: It starts at four and finishes at seven.

tasks.task: ASK if your friend is free on Friday (the examiner then answers).
tasks.model: هَلْ أَنْتَ مُتَفَرِّغٌ يَوْمَ الجُمُعَةِ؟
tasks.en: Are you free on Friday?

tasks.task: Answer the unexpected question (future).
tasks.model: سَنَأْكُلُ الكَعْكَةَ، وَنَلْعَبُ أَلْعَابًا مُمْتِعَةً فِي الحَدِيقَةِ.
tasks.en: We will eat cake and play fun games in the garden.

tasks.task: Say how many days you study, and which days.
tasks.model: أَدْرُسُ خَمْسَةَ أَيَّامٍ، مِنَ الإِثْنَيْنِ إِلَى الجُمُعَةِ.
tasks.en: I study five days, from Monday to Friday.

tasks.examiner: مَتَى يَبْدَأُ اليَوْمُ الدِّرَاسِيُّ، وَمَتَى يَنْتَهِي؟
tasks.task: Give start and finish times.
tasks.model: يَبْدَأُ فِي الثَّامِنَةِ وَالرُّبْعِ، وَيَنْتَهِي فِي الثَّالِثَةِ وَالنِّصْفِ.
tasks.en: It starts at quarter past eight and finishes at half past three.

tasks.task: Say how many lessons, and how long each lasts.
tasks.model: عِنْدِي سِتُّ حِصَصٍ، وَكُلُّ حِصَّةٍ خَمْسُونَ دَقِيقَةً.
tasks.en: I have six lessons, and each lesson is fifty minutes.

tasks.task: ASK when the summer holiday starts in Jordan (the examiner then answers).
tasks.model: مَتَى تَبْدَأُ العُطْلَةُ الصَّيْفِيَّةُ عِنْدَكُمْ؟
tasks.en: When does the summer holiday start for you?

tasks.examiner: مَا يَوْمُكَ المُفَضَّلُ فِي الأُسْبُوعِ؟ وَلِمَاذَا؟
tasks.task: Answer the unexpected question, with a reason.
tasks.model: يَوْمِي المُفَضَّلُ هُوَ الخَمِيسُ، لِأَنَّ عِنْدِي حِصَّتَيْنِ مِنَ الرِّيَاضَةِ.
tasks.en: My favourite day is Thursday, because I have two PE lessons.

roleplays.setting: An interview for the school council
roleplays.title: Changing the school week?
roleplays.examiner: the head of the school council

tasks.task: Describe your week briefly, with a comparison.
tasks.model: أَدْرُسُ مِنَ الإِثْنَيْنِ إِلَى الجُمُعَةِ؛ أَطْوَلُ يَوْمٍ هُوَ الثُّلَاثَاءُ لِأَنَّ عِنْدِي سَبْعَ حِصَصٍ، وَأَقْصَرُهُ الجُمُعَةُ.
tasks.en: I study Monday to Friday; the longest day is Tuesday because I have seven lessons, and the shortest is Friday.

tasks.task: Say what you did in the last holiday (past, with a date).
tasks.model: فِي العُطْلَةِ الأَخِيرَةِ، فِي شَهْرِ أَبْرِيلَ، سَافَرْتُ إِلَى مِصْرَ، وَزُرْتُ أَقَارِبِي أُسْبُوعَيْنِ.
tasks.en: In the last holiday, in April, I travelled to Egypt and visited my relatives for two weeks.

tasks.examiner: هَلْ تُفَضِّلُ أَنْ يَبْدَأَ اليَوْمُ مُبَكِّرًا أَمْ مُتَأَخِّرًا؟ لِمَاذَا؟
tasks.task: Give a preference and a reason.
tasks.model: أُفَضِّلُ أَنْ يَبْدَأَ فِي التَّاسِعَةِ، لِأَنَّ الطُّلَّابَ يَكُونُونَ أَكْثَرَ تَرْكِيزًا بَعْدَ النَّوْمِ الكَافِي.
tasks.en: I prefer it to start at nine, because students concentrate better after enough sleep.

tasks.examiner: مَا أَهَمُّ تَارِيخٍ فِي سَنَتِكَ؟ وَلِمَاذَا؟
tasks.task: Name an important date and explain why.
tasks.model: أَهَمُّ تَارِيخٍ عِنْدِي هُوَ أَوَّلُ يَوْمٍ مِنَ العِيدِ، لِأَنَّ الأُسْرَةَ كُلَّهَا تَجْتَمِعُ.
tasks.en: My most important date is the first day of Eid, because the whole family gets together.

tasks.examiner: كَيْفَ سَتُنَظِّمُ وَقْتَكَ فِي الشَّهْرِ القَادِمِ؟
tasks.task: Answer the unexpected question (future).
tasks.model: سَأَكْتُبُ مَوَاعِيدَ الامْتِحَانَاتِ فِي تَقْوِيمِي، وَسَأُرَاجِعُ سَاعَةً كُلَّ يَوْمٍ.
tasks.en: I will write the exam dates in my calendar and revise for an hour every day.

conversation.qen: What is the date today?
conversation.model: اليَوْمُ هُوَ الخَامِسُ مِنْ أُكْتُوبَرَ.
conversation.en: Today is the fifth of October.

conversation.qen: When is your birthday?
conversation.model: عِيدُ مِيلَادِي فِي الثَّالِثِ مِنْ مَارِسَ.
conversation.en: My birthday is on the third of March.

conversation.qen: How many days do you study a week?
conversation.model: أَدْرُسُ خَمْسَةَ أَيَّامٍ فِي الأُسْبُوعِ.
conversation.en: I study five days a week.

conversation.qen: When does school start?
conversation.model: تَبْدَأُ المَدْرَسَةُ فِي السَّاعَةِ الثَّامِنَةِ وَالنِّصْفِ.
conversation.en: School starts at half past eight.

conversation.qen: What is your favourite month?
conversation.model: شَهْرِي المُفَضَّلُ هُوَ أُغُسْطُسُ، لِأَنَّهُ فِي العُطْلَةِ.
conversation.en: My favourite month is August, because it is in the holidays.

conversation.qen: Describe Monday at your school.
conversation.model: يَوْمُ الإِثْنَيْنِ طَوِيلٌ؛ تَبْدَأُ الحِصَّةُ الأُولَى فِي الثَّامِنَةِ، ثُمَّ عِنْدِي الرِّيَاضِيَّاتُ وَالعُلُومُ، وَأَرْجِعُ إِلَى البَيْتِ فِي الرَّابِعَةِ.
conversation.en: Monday is long: the first lesson starts at eight, then I have maths and science, and I get home at four.

conversation.qen: Which day do you like most? Why?
conversation.model: أُحِبُّ يَوْمَ الأَرْبِعَاءِ أَكْثَرَ، لِأَنَّ عِنْدِي حِصَّةَ الفَنِّ وَحِصَّةَ الرِّيَاضَةِ.
conversation.en: I like Wednesday most, because I have art and PE.

conversation.q: مَاذَا تَفْعَلُ فِي نِهَايَةِ الأُسْبُوعِ عَادَةً؟
conversation.qen: What do you usually do at the weekend?
conversation.model: عَادَةً أَزُورُ جَدَّتِي يَوْمَ السَّبْتِ، وَأُرَاجِعُ دُرُوسِي يَوْمَ الأَحَدِ.
conversation.en: I usually visit my grandmother on Saturday and revise on Sunday.

conversation.q: مَتَى تَبْدَأُ العُطْلَةُ القَادِمَةُ؟ وَمَاذَا سَتَفْعَلُ؟
conversation.qen: When does the next holiday start? What will you do?
conversation.model: تَبْدَأُ فِي العِشْرِينَ مِنْ دِيسَمْبَرَ، وَسَأَزُورُ أَقَارِبِي فِي مَانْشِسْتَرَ.
conversation.en: It starts on the twentieth of December, and I will visit my relatives in Manchester.

conversation.qen: What did you do last Saturday?
conversation.model: يَوْمَ السَّبْتِ المَاضِي ذَهَبْتُ إِلَى المَكْتَبَةِ فِي العَاشِرَةِ، ثُمَّ لَعِبْتُ كُرَةَ القَدَمِ.
conversation.en: Last Saturday I went to the library at ten, then I played football.

conversation.q: قَارِنْ بَيْنَ أُسْبُوعِكَ الدِّرَاسِيِّ وَأُسْبُوعِ طَالِبٍ فِي بَلَدٍ عَرَبِيٍّ.
conversation.qen: Compare your school week with a student’s in an Arab country.
conversation.model: بَيْنَمَا نَدْرُسُ مِنَ الإِثْنَيْنِ إِلَى الجُمُعَةِ، يَدْرُسُ الطُّلَّابُ فِي بَعْضِ البُلْدَانِ العَرَبِيَّةِ مِنَ الأَحَدِ إِلَى الخَمِيسِ، لِأَنَّ الجُمُعَةَ عُطْلَةٌ هُنَاكَ.
conversation.en: While we study Monday to Friday, students in some Arab countries study Sunday to Thursday, because Friday is a holiday there.

conversation.q: هَلْ العُطْلَةُ الصَّيْفِيَّةُ طَوِيلَةٌ بِمَا يَكْفِي فِي رَأْيِكَ؟
conversation.qen: Is the summer holiday long enough, in your opinion?
conversation.model: أَعْتَقِدُ أَنَّهَا مُنَاسِبَةٌ، لِأَنَّهَا سِتَّةُ أَسَابِيعَ، لٰكِنَّ بَعْضَ الطُّلَّابِ يَنْسَوْنَ دُرُوسَهُمْ فِيهَا.
conversation.en: I think it is about right, because it is six weeks, but some students forget their lessons in it.

conversation.qen: How do you organise your appointments and homework?
conversation.model: أَكْتُبُ كُلَّ مَوْعِدٍ فِي تَقْوِيمٍ عَلَى هَاتِفِي، وَأُنْهِي الوَاجِبَ فِي اليَوْمِ نَفْسِهِ.
conversation.en: I write every appointment in a calendar on my phone, and finish homework on the same day.

conversation.q: كَيْفَ كَانَ أُسْبُوعُكَ فِي المَدْرَسَةِ الابْتِدَائِيَّةِ؟
conversation.qen: What was your week like in primary school?
conversation.model: فِي المَدْرَسَةِ الابْتِدَائِيَّةِ كَانَ اليَوْمُ أَقْصَرَ، وَكُنْتُ أَلْعَبُ أَكْثَرَ وَأَدْرُسُ أَقَلَّ.
conversation.en: In primary school the day was shorter, and I used to play more and study less.

conversation.q: لَوْ كَانَ عِنْدَكَ يَوْمٌ إِضَافِيٌّ فِي الأُسْبُوعِ، مَاذَا تَفْعَلُ؟
conversation.qen: If you had an extra day each week, what would you do?
conversation.model: لَوْ كَانَ عِنْدِي يَوْمٌ إِضَافِيٌّ، لَتَعَلَّمْتُ لُغَةً جَدِيدَةً، وَلَزُرْتُ أَصْدِقَائِي.
conversation.en: If I had an extra day, I would learn a new language and visit my friends.

lessons.title: Calendar and the School Week
lessons.intro: Paper 3 practice in breakout rooms: book, arrange and describe things with days, dates and times — then develop with reasons, past events and plans.

bank.title: Keep in touch — and link your ideas

roleplays.setting: A survey at the youth club
roleplays.title: The youth-club survey
roleplays.you: a member of the youth club
roleplays.examiner: the club leader doing a survey

tasks.examiner: كَمْ مَرَّةً تَأْتِي إِلَى النَّادِي فِي الأُسْبُوعِ؟
tasks.task: Say how often you come to the club.
tasks.model: آتِي إِلَى النَّادِي مَرَّتَيْنِ فِي الأُسْبُوعِ.
tasks.en: I come to the club twice a week.

tasks.task: Say what you usually do there.
tasks.model: عَادَةً أَلْعَبُ كُرَةَ الطَّاوِلَةِ مَعَ أَصْدِقَائِي.
tasks.en: I usually play table tennis with my friends.

tasks.task: Say if you are ever late.
tasks.model: لَا، لَا أَتَأَخَّرُ أَبَدًا، لِأَنِّي أَسْكُنُ قَرِيبًا.
tasks.en: No, I am never late, because I live nearby.

tasks.examiner: كَيْفَ تَتَوَاصَلُ مَعَ أَصْدِقَائِكَ فِي النَّادِي؟
tasks.task: Say how you keep in touch with club friends.
tasks.model: أُرْسِلُ رَسَائِلَ عَلَى الهَاتِفِ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ.
tasks.en: I send messages on my phone every day.

tasks.task: Answer the unexpected question.
tasks.model: بَعْدَ النَّادِي أَرْجِعُ إِلَى البَيْتِ وَأَتَنَاوَلُ العَشَاءَ.
tasks.en: After the club I go home and have dinner.

roleplays.setting: A phone call with your grandmother
roleplays.title: Calling your grandmother

tasks.examiner: كَمْ مَرَّةً تَتَّصِلُ بِي فِي الشَّهْرِ؟
tasks.task: Say how often you call her.
tasks.model: أَتَّصِلُ بِكِ مَرَّتَيْنِ فِي الشَّهْرِ، يَا جَدَّتِي.
tasks.en: I call you twice a month, Grandma.

tasks.examiner: مَاذَا تَفْعَلُ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَذْهَبَ إِلَى المَدْرَسَةِ؟
tasks.task: Say one thing you do before school.
tasks.model: قَبْلَ أَنْ أَذْهَبَ إِلَى المَدْرَسَةِ، أَتَنَاوَلُ الإِفْطَارَ مَعَ أُمِّي.
tasks.en: Before I go to school, I have breakfast with my mother.

tasks.examiner: وَمَاذَا تَفْعَلُ عِنْدَمَا تَرْجِعُ إِلَى البَيْتِ؟
tasks.task: Say what you do when you get home (two things in order).
tasks.model: عِنْدَمَا أَرْجِعُ إِلَى البَيْتِ، أَرْتَاحُ قَلِيلًا، ثُمَّ أُنْهِي وَاجِبَاتِي.
tasks.en: When I get home, I rest a little, then I finish my homework.

tasks.task: ASK what she usually does in the evening (she then answers).
tasks.model: وَأَنْتِ يَا جَدَّتِي، مَاذَا تَفْعَلِينَ فِي المَسَاءِ عَادَةً؟
tasks.en: And you, Grandma, what do you usually do in the evening?

tasks.task: Answer the unexpected question (future).
tasks.model: سَأَزُورُكِ يَوْمَ السَّبْتِ القَادِمِ بَعْدَ الظُّهْرِ، إِنْ شَاءَ اللّٰهُ.
tasks.en: I will visit you next Saturday afternoon, God willing.

roleplays.title: A new classmate
roleplays.you: a student helping a new classmate

tasks.examiner: مَاذَا يَحْدُثُ فِي الصَّبَاحِ عِنْدَمَا نَصِلُ؟
tasks.task: Explain the morning routine in order.
tasks.model: أَوَّلًا نَذْهَبُ إِلَى التَّسْجِيلِ، ثُمَّ تَبْدَأُ الحِصَّةُ الأُولَى، وَبَعْدَ ذٰلِكَ نَأْخُذُ اسْتِرَاحَةً قَصِيرَةً.
tasks.en: First we go to registration, then the first lesson starts, and after that we have a short break.

tasks.examiner: كَمْ مَرَّةً عِنْدَنَا وَاجِبٌ فِي العَرَبِيَّةِ؟
tasks.task: Say how often there is Arabic homework.
tasks.model: عِنْدَنَا وَاجِبٌ ثَلَاثَ مَرَّاتٍ فِي الأُسْبُوعِ عَادَةً، وَأَحْيَانًا امْتِحَانٌ قَصِيرٌ.
tasks.en: We usually have homework three times a week, and sometimes a short test.

tasks.examiner: كَيْفَ تَتَوَاصَلُ مَعَ المُعَلِّمِ إِذَا كَانَ عِنْدَكَ سُؤَالٌ؟
tasks.task: Explain how you contact the teacher.
tasks.model: أُرْسِلُ لَهُ رِسَالَةً عَلَى المَنَصَّةِ، أَوْ أَسْأَلُهُ بَعْدَ الحِصَّةِ.
tasks.en: I send him a message on the platform, or I ask him after the lesson.

tasks.task: ASK what time lunch is (the examiner then answers).
tasks.model: فِي أَيِّ سَاعَةٍ نَتَنَاوَلُ الغَدَاءَ؟
tasks.en: What time do we have lunch?

tasks.task: Answer the unexpected question, with a reason.
tasks.model: قَبْلَ الامْتِحَانِ دَائِمًا أُرَاجِعُ مُلَاحَظَاتِي وَأَنَامُ مُبَكِّرًا، لِأَنَّ النَّوْمَ يُسَاعِدُنِي عَلَى التَّرْكِيزِ.
tasks.en: Before an exam I always revise my notes and sleep early, because sleep helps me concentrate.

roleplays.setting: An interview for a school-magazine article
roleplays.title: Screens and communication

tasks.examiner: كَمْ سَاعَةً تَسْتَعْمِلُ الهَاتِفَ يَوْمِيًّا؟ وَفِي أَيِّ أَوْقَاتٍ؟
tasks.task: Give a time and when you use it, with a connector.
tasks.model: أَسْتَعْمِلُهُ سَاعَتَيْنِ تَقْرِيبًا؛ عِنْدَمَا أَرْجِعُ مِنَ المَدْرَسَةِ أُرْسِلُ رَسَائِلَ لِأَصْدِقَائِي، أَمَّا فِي اللَّيْلِ فَأُطْفِئُهُ.
tasks.en: About two hours; when I get back from school I message my friends, but at night I switch it off.

tasks.examiner: كَيْفَ كُنْتَ تَتَوَاصَلُ مَعَ أَقَارِبِكَ عِنْدَمَا كُنْتَ صَغِيرًا؟
tasks.task: Describe a past habit.
tasks.model: عِنْدَمَا كُنْتُ صَغِيرًا، كُنْتُ أَتَّصِلُ بِجَدِّي بِالهَاتِفِ الأَرْضِيِّ مَرَّةً فِي الأُسْبُوعِ فَقَطْ.
tasks.en: When I was little, I used to call my grandfather on the landline only once a week.

tasks.examiner: هَلْ الرَّسَائِلُ أَفْضَلُ مِنَ المُكَالَمَاتِ فِي رَأْيِكَ؟
tasks.task: Give an opinion with a reason and a contrast.
tasks.model: فِي رَأْيِي الرَّسَائِلُ أَسْرَعُ، لٰكِنَّ المُكَالَمَاتِ أَدْفَأُ، لِأَنَّنَا نَسْمَعُ الصَّوْتَ وَنَفْهَمُ المَشَاعِرَ.
tasks.en: In my opinion messages are quicker, but calls are warmer, because we hear the voice and understand the feelings.

tasks.examiner: مَاذَا فَعَلْتَ أَمْسِ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَنَامَ؟
tasks.task: Say what you did yesterday before sleeping (past + qabla an).
tasks.model: أَمْسِ، قَبْلَ أَنْ أَنَامَ، قَرَأْتُ كِتَابًا نِصْفَ سَاعَةٍ، وَلَمْ أَسْتَعْمِلِ الهَاتِفَ أَبَدًا.
tasks.en: Yesterday, before I slept, I read a book for half an hour and did not use my phone at all.

tasks.examiner: مَا نَصِيحَتُكَ لِطَالِبٍ يَسْتَعْمِلُ الهَاتِفَ كَثِيرًا؟
tasks.task: Answer the unexpected question with advice.
tasks.model: أَنْصَحُهُ بِأَنْ يُطْفِئَ الهَاتِفَ سَاعَةً قَبْلَ النَّوْمِ، وَأَنْ يَتَّصِلَ بِأَصْدِقَائِهِ بَدَلًا مِنَ الرَّسَائِلِ الكَثِيرَةِ.
tasks.en: I advise him to switch off his phone an hour before bed, and to call his friends instead of sending lots of messages.

conversation.qen: How often do you do sport?
conversation.model: أُمَارِسُ الرِّيَاضَةَ ثَلَاثَ مَرَّاتٍ فِي الأُسْبُوعِ.
conversation.en: I do sport three times a week.

conversation.qen: Do you read books?
conversation.model: نَعَمْ، أَقْرَأُ الكُتُبَ أَحْيَانًا فِي المَسَاءِ.
conversation.en: Yes, I sometimes read books in the evening.

conversation.qen: How do you keep in touch with friends?
conversation.model: أُرْسِلُ رَسَائِلَ لِأَصْدِقَائِي كُلَّ يَوْمٍ.
conversation.en: I send messages to my friends every day.

conversation.qen: What do you do before sleeping?
conversation.model: قَبْلَ النَّوْمِ أُنَظِّفُ أَسْنَانِي وَأَقْرَأُ قَلِيلًا.
conversation.en: Before sleeping I brush my teeth and read a little.

conversation.qen: Are you ever late for school?
conversation.model: نَادِرًا مَا أَتَأَخَّرُ عَنِ المَدْرَسَةِ.
conversation.en: I am rarely late for school.

conversation.q: صِفْ مَاذَا تَفْعَلُ بَعْدَ المَدْرَسَةِ بِالتَّرْتِيبِ.
conversation.qen: Describe what you do after school, in order.
conversation.model: عِنْدَمَا أَرْجِعُ مِنَ المَدْرَسَةِ أَتَنَاوَلُ الغَدَاءَ، ثُمَّ أُنْهِي وَاجِبَاتِي، وَبَعْدَ ذٰلِكَ أَلْعَبُ مَعَ أَخِي.
conversation.en: When I get back from school I have lunch, then I finish my homework, and after that I play with my brother.

conversation.qen: How often do you call relatives? Why?
conversation.model: أَتَّصِلُ بِخَالَتِي مَرَّةً فِي الأُسْبُوعِ، لِأَنَّهَا تَسْكُنُ فِي بَاكِسْتَانَ وَنَشْتَاقُ إِلَيْهَا.
conversation.en: I call my aunt once a week, because she lives in Pakistan and we miss her.

conversation.q: مَاذَا تَفْعَلُ عَادَةً قَبْلَ أَنْ تَذْهَبَ إِلَى المَدْرَسَةِ؟
conversation.qen: What do you usually do before going to school?
conversation.model: قَبْلَ أَنْ أَذْهَبَ إِلَى المَدْرَسَةِ، أُرَتِّبُ حَقِيبَتِي وَأَتَنَاوَلُ الإِفْطَارَ بِسُرْعَةٍ.
conversation.en: Before I go to school, I pack my bag and have breakfast quickly.

conversation.q: مَا الشَّيْءُ الَّذِي لَا تَفْعَلُهُ أَبَدًا؟
conversation.qen: What is something you never do?
conversation.model: لَا أَشْرَبُ المَشْرُوبَاتِ الغَازِيَّةَ أَبَدًا، لِأَنَّهَا غَيْرُ صِحِّيَّةٍ.
conversation.en: I never drink fizzy drinks, because they are unhealthy.

conversation.q: مَاذَا فَعَلْتَ أَمْسِ بَعْدَ أَنْ رَجَعْتَ إِلَى البَيْتِ؟
conversation.qen: What did you do yesterday after getting home?
conversation.model: بَعْدَ أَنْ رَجَعْتُ إِلَى البَيْتِ، اتَّصَلْتُ بِصَدِيقِي، ثُمَّ ذَاكَرْنَا مَعًا عَلَى الإِنْتَرْنِتِ.
conversation.en: After I got home, I called my friend, then we studied together online.

conversation.q: كَيْفَ تَغَيَّرَ التَّوَاصُلُ بَيْنَ النَّاسِ فِي رَأْيِكَ؟
conversation.qen: How has communication between people changed?
conversation.starter: فِي المَاضِي كَانَ … أَمَّا اليَوْمَ فَنَتَوَاصَلُ …
conversation.model: فِي المَاضِي كَانَ النَّاسُ يَكْتُبُونَ رَسَائِلَ وَرَقِيَّةً، أَمَّا اليَوْمَ فَنَتَوَاصَلُ فَوْرًا بِالهَاتِفِ وَالإِنْتَرْنِتِ.
conversation.en: In the past people wrote paper letters; today we communicate instantly by phone and internet.

conversation.q: هَلْ يَقْضِي الشَّبَابُ وَقْتًا طَوِيلًا عَلَى الشَّاشَاتِ؟
conversation.qen: Do young people spend too long on screens?
conversation.model: أَعْتَقِدُ أَنَّ كَثِيرًا مِنَ الشَّبَابِ يَقْضُونَ وَقْتًا طَوِيلًا عَلَيْهَا، لِأَنَّهُمْ يَدْرُسُونَ وَيَلْعَبُونَ وَيَتَوَاصَلُونَ بِهَا.
conversation.en: I think many young people spend a long time on them, because they study, play and communicate with them.

conversation.q: مَا الَّذِي تَفْعَلُهُ دَائِمًا لِتُنَظِّمَ يَوْمَكَ؟
conversation.qen: What do you always do to organise your day?
conversation.model: دَائِمًا أَكْتُبُ قَائِمَةً بِالمَهَامِّ قَبْلَ أَنْ أَنَامَ، وَعِنْدَمَا أَسْتَيْقِظُ أَبْدَأُ بِأَصْعَبِهَا.
conversation.en: I always write a to-do list before I sleep, and when I wake up I start with the hardest task.

conversation.qen: Describe an important call you made.
conversation.model: فِي العِيدِ المَاضِي اتَّصَلْتُ بِجَدِّي فِي مِصْرَ بِالفِيدْيُو، فَرَأَى أُسْرَتَنَا كُلَّهَا وَفَرِحَ كَثِيرًا.
conversation.en: Last Eid I video-called my grandfather in Egypt; he saw our whole family and was very happy.

conversation.q: لَوْ لَمْ يَكُنْ هُنَاكَ هَاتِفٌ، كَيْفَ تَتَوَاصَلُ؟
conversation.qen: If there were no phones, how would you communicate?
conversation.starter: لَوْ لَمْ يَكُنْ هُنَاكَ هَاتِفٌ، لَكَتَبْتُ …
conversation.model: لَوْ لَمْ يَكُنْ هُنَاكَ هَاتِفٌ، لَكَتَبْتُ رَسَائِلَ لِأَصْدِقَائِي، وَلَزُرْتُهُمْ أَكْثَرَ.
conversation.en: If there were no phone, I would write letters to my friends and visit them more.

lessons.title: Frequency and Communication
lessons.intro: Paper 3 practice in breakout rooms: say how often you do things, put events in order with before / after / when, and talk about how you keep in touch.

tasks.examiner: أَهْلًا بِكَ! مَاذَا تُحِبُّ أَنْ تَأْكُلَ؟
tasks.task: Say what you like to eat.
tasks.model: أُحِبُّ الدَّجَاجَ وَالأُرْزَ كَثِيرًا.
tasks.en: I really like chicken and rice.

tasks.task: Say if you eat fish.
tasks.model: لَا، لَا آكُلُ السَّمَكَ، لٰكِنِّي أُحِبُّ اللَّحْمَ.
tasks.en: No, I don’t eat fish, but I like meat.

tasks.task: Say what you would like to drink.
tasks.model: أَشْرَبُ عَصِيرَ البُرْتُقَالِ، مِنْ فَضْلِكِ.
tasks.en: I’ll drink orange juice, please.

tasks.task: Say your favourite fruit.
tasks.model: فَاكِهَتِي المُفَضَّلَةُ هِيَ المَانْجُو.
tasks.en: My favourite fruit is mango.

tasks.task: Answer the unexpected question.
tasks.model: نَعَمْ، الطَّعَامُ لَذِيذٌ جِدًّا، شُكْرًا جَزِيلًا.
tasks.en: Yes, the food is very delicious, thank you very much.

roleplays.setting: A survey about the school canteen
roleplays.title: The canteen survey

tasks.task: Say what time you have lunch.
tasks.model: أَتَنَاوَلُ الغَدَاءَ فِي السَّاعَةِ الوَاحِدَةِ إِلَّا رُبْعًا.
tasks.en: I have lunch at quarter to one.

tasks.task: Say what you usually eat there.
tasks.model: عَادَةً آكُلُ شَطِيرَةَ جُبْنٍ وَتُفَّاحَةً.
tasks.en: I usually eat a cheese sandwich and an apple.

tasks.task: Give your opinion, with a “but”.
tasks.model: طَعَامُ المَقْصَفِ لَذِيذٌ، لٰكِنَّهُ غَالٍ قَلِيلًا.
tasks.en: The canteen food is tasty, but it is a bit expensive.

tasks.examiner: … نَعَمْ، عِنْدَنَا شُورْبَةُ العَدَسِ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ.
tasks.task: ASK if there are vegetarian dishes (the examiner then answers).
tasks.model: هَلْ عِنْدَكُمْ أَطْبَاقٌ نَبَاتِيَّةٌ؟
tasks.en: Do you have vegetarian dishes?

tasks.examiner: مَاذَا تُرِيدُ أَنْ نُضِيفَ إِلَى القَائِمَةِ؟
tasks.task: Answer the unexpected question.
tasks.model: أُرِيدُ أَنْ تُضِيفُوا سَلَطَةَ فَوَاكِهَ طَازَجَةً، لِأَنَّهَا صِحِّيَّةٌ.
tasks.en: I would like you to add a fresh fruit salad, because it is healthy.

tasks.examiner: كَمْ وَجْبَةً تَتَنَاوَلُ فِي اليَوْمِ؟ وَمَتَى؟
tasks.task: Describe your meals and when you eat them.
tasks.model: أَتَنَاوَلُ ثَلَاثَ وَجَبَاتٍ: الفُطُورَ فِي السَّابِعَةِ، وَالغَدَاءَ فِي المَدْرَسَةِ، وَالعَشَاءَ مَعَ أُسْرَتِي.
tasks.en: I have three meals: breakfast at seven, lunch at school and dinner with my family.

tasks.task: Name the family’s favourite dish and why.
tasks.model: الطَّبَقُ المُفَضَّلُ فِي أُسْرَتِي هُوَ البِرْيَانِي، لِأَنَّ أُمِّي تَطْبُخُهُ بِبَهَارَاتٍ لَذِيذَةٍ.
tasks.en: My family’s favourite dish is biryani, because my mother cooks it with delicious spices.

tasks.task: Say how you help in the kitchen (two things).
tasks.model: نَعَمْ، أُسَاعِدُ أُمِّي أَحْيَانًا؛ أَغْسِلُ الخُضَارَ وَأُحَضِّرُ السَّلَطَةَ.
tasks.en: Yes, I sometimes help my mother: I wash the vegetables and make the salad.

tasks.task: ASK what the famous dish in Jordan is (the examiner then answers).
tasks.model: مَا الأَكْلَةُ المَشْهُورَةُ فِي بَلَدِكُمْ؟
tasks.en: What is the famous dish in your country?

tasks.examiner: مَا الطَّعَامُ الَّذِي لَا تُحِبُّهُ؟ لِمَاذَا؟
tasks.task: Answer the unexpected question, with a reason.
tasks.model: لَا أُحِبُّ البَصَلَ النِّيءَ، لِأَنَّ طَعْمَهُ قَوِيٌّ جِدًّا.
tasks.en: I don’t like raw onion, because its taste is very strong.

roleplays.setting: A radio programme about food and culture
roleplays.title: Food, family and culture

tasks.task: Describe your family’s food habits, with a preference.
tasks.model: نَتَنَاوَلُ العَشَاءَ مَعًا كُلَّ مَسَاءٍ، وَنُفَضِّلُ الأَطْبَاقَ البَيْتِيَّةَ عَلَى الوَجَبَاتِ السَّرِيعَةِ.
tasks.en: We have dinner together every evening, and we prefer home-made dishes to fast food.

tasks.examiner: مَاذَا أَكَلْتُمْ فِي آخِرِ مُنَاسَبَةٍ عَائِلِيَّةٍ؟
tasks.task: Describe food at a recent family occasion (past).
tasks.model: فِي العِيدِ المَاضِي أَكَلْنَا لَحْمَ الخَرُوفِ مَعَ الأُرْزِ، وَحَضَّرَتْ جَدَّتِي حَلَوِيَّاتٍ كَثِيرَةً.
tasks.en: Last Eid we ate lamb with rice, and my grandmother made lots of sweets.

tasks.examiner: هَلْ تُفَضِّلُ الطَّعَامَ التَّقْلِيدِيَّ أَمِ الحَدِيثَ؟ لِمَاذَا؟
tasks.task: Give a preference, a reason and a contrast.
tasks.model: أُفَضِّلُ الطَّعَامَ التَّقْلِيدِيَّ لِأَنَّهُ يُذَكِّرُنِي بِبَلَدِ أَجْدَادِي، لٰكِنِّي أُحِبُّ تَجْرِبَةَ أَطْبَاقٍ جَدِيدَةٍ أَيْضًا.
tasks.en: I prefer traditional food because it reminds me of my grandparents’ country, but I also like trying new dishes.

tasks.examiner: قَارِنْ بَيْنَ الطَّعَامِ فِي بَلَدَيْنِ تَعْرِفُهُمَا.
tasks.task: Compare food in two countries.
tasks.model: بَيْنَمَا يُحِبُّ البِرِيطَانِيُّونَ السَّمَكَ وَالبَطَاطَا، يُفَضِّلُ النَّاسُ فِي بَاكِسْتَانَ الأَطْعِمَةَ الحَارَّةَ بِالبَهَارَاتِ.
tasks.en: While British people like fish and chips, people in Pakistan prefer spicy food with spices.

tasks.examiner: لَوْ كُنْتَ طَبَّاخًا، مَاذَا تُحَضِّرُ لِضُيُوفِكَ؟
tasks.task: Answer the unexpected question (a conditional).
tasks.model: لَوْ كُنْتُ طَبَّاخًا، لَحَضَّرْتُ لَهُمْ شُورْبَةً سَاخِنَةً، ثُمَّ دَجَاجًا مَشْوِيًّا مَعَ الأُرْزِ.
tasks.en: If I were a chef, I would make them a hot soup, then grilled chicken with rice.

conversation.qen: What do you eat for breakfast?
conversation.model: آكُلُ الخُبْزَ وَالبَيْضَ فِي الفُطُورِ.
conversation.en: I eat bread and eggs for breakfast.

conversation.qen: What is your favourite food?
conversation.model: طَعَامِي المُفَضَّلُ هُوَ البِيتْزَا.
conversation.en: My favourite food is pizza.

conversation.qen: What do you usually drink?
conversation.model: أَشْرَبُ المَاءَ وَالحَلِيبَ عَادَةً.
conversation.en: I usually drink water and milk.

conversation.qen: Do you like vegetables?
conversation.model: نَعَمْ، أُحِبُّ الجَزَرَ وَالخِيَارَ.
conversation.en: Yes, I like carrots and cucumber.

conversation.qen: Where do you have lunch?
conversation.model: أَتَنَاوَلُ الغَدَاءَ فِي مَقْصَفِ المَدْرَسَةِ.
conversation.en: I have lunch in the school canteen.

conversation.qen: Describe dinner at your home.
conversation.model: نَتَنَاوَلُ العَشَاءَ فِي السَّابِعَةِ؛ عَادَةً نَأْكُلُ الأُرْزَ وَالدَّجَاجَ وَالسَّلَطَةَ، ثُمَّ نَأْكُلُ الفَاكِهَةَ.
conversation.en: We have dinner at seven: we usually eat rice, chicken and salad, then fruit.

conversation.q: مَا الطَّعَامُ الَّذِي لَا تُحِبُّهُ؟ لِمَاذَا؟
conversation.qen: What food don’t you like? Why?
conversation.model: لَا أُحِبُّ السَّمَكَ، لِأَنَّ رَائِحَتَهُ قَوِيَّةٌ.
conversation.en: I don’t like fish, because its smell is strong.

conversation.qen: Who cooks in your house?
conversation.model: تَطْبُخُ أُمِّي غَالِبًا، وَأَحْيَانًا يَطْبُخُ أَبِي فِي نِهَايَةِ الأُسْبُوعِ.
conversation.en: My mother usually cooks, and sometimes my father cooks at the weekend.

conversation.qen: What did you eat yesterday?
conversation.model: أَمْسِ أَكَلْتُ مَعْكَرُونَةً بِالطَّمَاطِمِ فِي الغَدَاءِ، وَشُورْبَةَ عَدَسٍ فِي العَشَاءِ.
conversation.en: Yesterday I ate pasta with tomatoes for lunch and lentil soup for dinner.

conversation.q: مَا الأَكْلَةُ الَّتِي تُرِيدُ أَنْ تَتَعَلَّمَ طَبْخَهَا؟
conversation.qen: Which dish would you like to learn to cook?
conversation.model: أُرِيدُ أَنْ أَتَعَلَّمَ طَبْخَ البِرْيَانِي، لِأَنَّهُ طَبَقُ أُسْرَتِي المُفَضَّلُ.
conversation.en: I want to learn to cook biryani, because it is my family’s favourite dish.

conversation.q: هَلْ تَأْكُلُ أُسْرَتُكَ مَعًا؟ مَا أَهَمِّيَّةُ ذٰلِكَ؟
conversation.qen: Does your family eat together? Why does it matter?
conversation.model: نَعَمْ، نَأْكُلُ مَعًا كُلَّ مَسَاءٍ، وَهٰذَا مُهِمٌّ لِأَنَّنَا نَتَحَدَّثُ عَنْ يَوْمِنَا وَنَشْعُرُ بِالقُرْبِ.
conversation.en: Yes, we eat together every evening; it matters because we talk about our day and feel close.

conversation.q: كَيْفَ تَغَيَّرَتْ عَادَاتُ الأَكْلِ فِي رَأْيِكَ؟
conversation.qen: How have eating habits changed?
conversation.starter: فِي المَاضِي كَانَ النَّاسُ … أَمَّا اليَوْمَ فَيَطْلُبُونَ …
conversation.model: فِي المَاضِي كَانَ النَّاسُ يَطْبُخُونَ فِي البَيْتِ دَائِمًا، أَمَّا اليَوْمَ فَيَطْلُبُونَ الوَجَبَاتِ السَّرِيعَةَ كَثِيرًا.
conversation.en: In the past people always cooked at home; today they order fast food a lot.

conversation.q: صِفْ أَكْلَةً تَقْلِيدِيَّةً مِنْ بَلَدِ أُسْرَتِكَ.
conversation.qen: Describe a traditional dish from your family’s country.
conversation.model: الكُسْكُسِي أَكْلَةٌ مَغْرِبِيَّةٌ مَشْهُورَةٌ، تُطْبَخُ بِالخُضَارِ وَاللَّحْمِ، وَنَأْكُلُهَا يَوْمَ الجُمُعَةِ عَادَةً.
conversation.en: Couscous is a famous Moroccan dish, cooked with vegetables and meat, and we usually eat it on Fridays.

conversation.qen: What is the best meal you remember?
conversation.model: أَجْمَلُ وَجْبَةٍ أَتَذَكَّرُهَا كَانَتْ فِي مَطْعَمٍ عَلَى البَحْرِ؛ أَكَلْنَا سَمَكًا مَشْوِيًّا وَضَحِكْنَا كَثِيرًا.
conversation.en: The best meal I remember was in a restaurant by the sea: we ate grilled fish and laughed a lot.

conversation.q: لَوْ فَتَحْتَ مَطْعَمًا، مَاذَا تُقَدِّمُ فِيهِ؟
conversation.qen: If you opened a restaurant, what would you serve?
conversation.model: لَوْ فَتَحْتُ مَطْعَمًا، لَقَدَّمْتُ أَطْبَاقًا مِنْ بُلْدَانٍ مُخْتَلِفَةٍ، لِكَيْ يَتَعَرَّفَ النَّاسُ عَلَى ثَقَافَاتٍ جَدِيدَةٍ.
conversation.en: If I opened a restaurant, I would serve dishes from different countries, so that people get to know new cultures.

lessons.title: Food and Drink
lessons.intro: Paper 3 practice in breakout rooms: say what you eat and drink, give preferences with reasons, describe meals and family food traditions.

tasks.task: Order a drink and something to eat.
tasks.model: أُرِيدُ فِنْجَانَ شَايٍ وَقِطْعَةَ كَعْكٍ، مِنْ فَضْلِكَ.
tasks.en: I would like a cup of tea and a piece of cake, please.

tasks.task: Say yes or no, politely.
tasks.model: نَعَمْ، مِلْعَقَةً وَاحِدَةً، مِنْ فَضْلِكَ.
tasks.en: Yes, one spoonful, please.

tasks.task: ASK how much the cake is (the examiner then answers).
tasks.model: كَمْ ثَمَنُ الكَعْكَةِ؟
tasks.en: How much is the cake?

tasks.examiner: هَلْ تَجْلِسُ فِي الدَّاخِلِ أَمْ فِي الخَارِجِ؟
tasks.task: Say where you want to sit, and why.
tasks.model: أَجْلِسُ فِي الخَارِجِ، لِأَنَّ الجَوَّ جَمِيلٌ.
tasks.en: I’ll sit outside, because the weather is lovely.

tasks.task: Answer the unexpected question.
tasks.model: لَا، شُكْرًا. الحِسَابُ، مِنْ فَضْلِكَ.
tasks.en: No, thank you. The bill, please.

roleplays.setting: A phone call to a restaurant
roleplays.title: Booking a table

tasks.task: Say you want to book a table.
tasks.model: أُرِيدُ أَنْ أَحْجِزَ طَاوِلَةً، مِنْ فَضْلِكَ.
tasks.en: I would like to book a table, please.

tasks.task: Say how many people.
tasks.model: لِخَمْسَةِ أَشْخَاصٍ.
tasks.en: For five people.

tasks.examiner: فِي أَيِّ يَوْمٍ، وَفِي أَيِّ سَاعَةٍ؟
tasks.task: Give the day and the time.
tasks.model: يَوْمَ الجُمُعَةِ، فِي السَّاعَةِ الثَّامِنَةِ مَسَاءً.
tasks.en: On Friday, at eight in the evening.

tasks.task: ASK if they have dishes for children (the examiner then answers).
tasks.model: هَلْ عِنْدَكُمْ أَطْبَاقٌ لِلْأَطْفَالِ؟
tasks.en: Do you have dishes for children?

tasks.task: Answer the unexpected question.
tasks.model: الحَجْزُ بِاسْمِ آدَمَ حُسَيْنٍ، شُكْرًا لَكَ.
tasks.en: The booking is in the name of Adam Hussain, thank you.

tasks.task: Explain the problem politely.
tasks.model: عَفْوًا، الشُّورْبَةُ بَارِدَةٌ، وَأَنَا طَلَبْتُ شُورْبَةً سَاخِنَةً.
tasks.en: Excuse me, the soup is cold, and I ordered a hot soup.

tasks.task: Say what you would like him to do.
tasks.model: أَرْجُو أَنْ تُسَخِّنَهَا، أَوْ أَنْ تُحْضِرَ لِي طَبَقًا آخَرَ.
tasks.en: Please heat it up, or bring me another dish.

tasks.task: Say what else you ordered (past).
tasks.model: طَلَبْتُ دَجَاجًا مَشْوِيًّا مَعَ الأُرْزِ، وَعَصِيرَ لَيْمُونٍ.
tasks.en: I ordered grilled chicken with rice, and a lemon juice.

tasks.task: ASK if service is included in the bill (the examiner then answers).
tasks.model: هَلِ الخِدْمَةُ مَحْسُوبَةٌ فِي الفَاتُورَةِ؟
tasks.en: Is service included in the bill?

tasks.task: Answer the unexpected question, with a reason.
tasks.model: نَعَمْ، سَأَرْجِعُ، لِأَنَّ الطَّعَامَ لَذِيذٌ وَالخِدْمَةَ سَرِيعَةٌ.
tasks.en: Yes, I will come back, because the food is tasty and the service is quick.

tasks.task: Give the number of students and the budget.
tasks.model: سَيَأْتِي عِشْرُونَ طَالِبًا، وَمِيزَانِيَّتُنَا مِئَتَا دِينَارٍ تَقْرِيبًا.
tasks.en: Twenty students will come, and our budget is about two hundred dinars.

tasks.examiner: مَاذَا تُفَضِّلُونَ: الوَجَبَاتِ السَّرِيعَةَ أَمِ الأَطْبَاقَ العَرَبِيَّةَ؟
tasks.task: Give a preference with two reasons.
tasks.model: نُفَضِّلُ الأَطْبَاقَ العَرَبِيَّةَ، لِأَنَّهَا أَصَحُّ، وَلِأَنَّ بَعْضَ زُمَلَائِنَا لَا يَأْكُلُونَ الوَجَبَاتِ السَّرِيعَةَ.
tasks.en: We prefer Arabic dishes, because they are healthier, and because some classmates don’t eat fast food.

tasks.examiner: هَلْ أَكَلْتُمْ مَعًا فِي مَطْعَمٍ مِنْ قَبْلُ؟
tasks.task: Describe a past class meal.
tasks.model: نَعَمْ، فِي السَّنَةِ المَاضِيَةِ تَنَاوَلْنَا الغَدَاءَ فِي مَطْعَمٍ لُبْنَانِيٍّ، وَكَانَتِ التَّجْرِبَةُ رَائِعَةً.
tasks.en: Yes, last year we had lunch in a Lebanese restaurant, and it was a great experience.

tasks.examiner: مَا الَّذِي يَجْعَلُ المَطْعَمَ جَيِّدًا فِي رَأْيِكَ؟
tasks.task: Give an opinion with a comparison.
tasks.model: فِي رَأْيِي، الطَّعَامُ الطَّازَجُ وَالأَسْعَارُ المَعْقُولَةُ أَهَمُّ مِنَ الدِّيكُورِ الفَاخِرِ.
tasks.en: In my opinion, fresh food and reasonable prices matter more than luxurious decor.

tasks.examiner: لَوْ كَانَتِ المِيزَانِيَّةُ أَكْبَرَ، مَاذَا تَطْلُبُونَ؟
tasks.task: Answer the unexpected question (a conditional).
tasks.model: لَوْ كَانَتِ المِيزَانِيَّةُ أَكْبَرَ، لَطَلَبْنَا حَلْوَى خَاصَّةً وَكَعْكَةً كَبِيرَةً لِلِاحْتِفَالِ.
tasks.en: If the budget were bigger, we would order a special dessert and a big cake to celebrate.

conversation.qen: Do you go to restaurants often?
conversation.model: نَعَمْ، أَذْهَبُ إِلَى المَطْعَمِ مَرَّةً فِي الشَّهْرِ.
conversation.en: Yes, I go to a restaurant once a month.

conversation.qen: What do you usually order in a café?
conversation.model: أَطْلُبُ عَادَةً عَصِيرَ فَرَاوِلَةٍ وَكَعْكَةً.
conversation.en: I usually order a strawberry juice and a cake.

conversation.qen: What is your favourite restaurant?
conversation.model: مَطْعَمِي المُفَضَّلُ مَطْعَمٌ إِيطَالِيٌّ قَرِيبٌ مِنْ بَيْتِي.
conversation.en: My favourite restaurant is an Italian restaurant near my house.

conversation.qen: Who do you go with?
conversation.model: أَذْهَبُ مَعَ أُسْرَتِي أَوْ مَعَ أَصْدِقَائِي.
conversation.en: I go with my family or my friends.

conversation.qen: Are restaurants expensive?
conversation.model: نَعَمْ، بَعْضُ المَطَاعِمِ غَالِيَةٌ جِدًّا.
conversation.en: Yes, some restaurants are very expensive.

conversation.qen: Describe your favourite restaurant.
conversation.model: مَطْعَمِي المُفَضَّلُ صَغِيرٌ وَهَادِئٌ، وَالطَّعَامُ فِيهِ لَذِيذٌ، وَالأَسْعَارُ مَعْقُولَةٌ.
conversation.en: My favourite restaurant is small and quiet; the food is tasty and the prices are reasonable.

conversation.qen: What do you order in an Arabic restaurant?
conversation.model: أَطْلُبُ الحُمُّصَ وَالفَلَافِلَ أَوَّلًا، ثُمَّ أَطْلُبُ المَشَاوِيَ.
conversation.en: I order hummus and falafel first, then grilled meats.

conversation.q: هَلْ تُفَضِّلُ الأَكْلَ فِي المَطْعَمِ أَمْ فِي البَيْتِ؟
conversation.qen: Do you prefer eating out or at home?
conversation.model: أُفَضِّلُ الأَكْلَ فِي البَيْتِ لِأَنَّهُ أَرْخَصُ وَأَصَحُّ، لٰكِنَّ المَطْعَمَ مُمْتِعٌ فِي المُنَاسَبَاتِ.
conversation.en: I prefer eating at home because it is cheaper and healthier, but restaurants are fun on special occasions.

conversation.q: مَتَى ذَهَبْتَ إِلَى مَطْعَمٍ آخِرَ مَرَّةٍ؟
conversation.qen: When did you last go to a restaurant?
conversation.model: ذَهَبْتُ الأُسْبُوعَ المَاضِيَ مَعَ أُسْرَتِي، وَأَكَلْتُ سَمَكًا مَشْوِيًّا.
conversation.en: I went last week with my family and ate grilled fish.

conversation.qen: How much do you usually pay in a café?
conversation.model: أَدْفَعُ عَادَةً خَمْسَةَ جُنَيْهَاتٍ تَقْرِيبًا ثَمَنَ عَصِيرٍ وَكَعْكَةٍ.
conversation.en: I usually pay about five pounds for a juice and a cake.

conversation.q: مَا الَّذِي يَجْعَلُ المَطْعَمَ نَاجِحًا فِي رَأْيِكَ؟
conversation.qen: What makes a restaurant successful?
conversation.model: أَعْتَقِدُ أَنَّ الطَّعَامَ الطَّازَجَ وَالخِدْمَةَ اللَّطِيفَةَ أَهَمُّ مِنَ المَكَانِ الفَاخِرِ، لِأَنَّ الزَّبُونَ يَرْجِعُ إِذَا شَعَرَ بِالتَّرْحِيبِ.
conversation.en: I think fresh food and friendly service matter more than a luxurious place, because customers come back if they feel welcome.

conversation.q: قَارِنْ بَيْنَ المَقَاهِي هُنَا وَفِي البُلْدَانِ العَرَبِيَّةِ.
conversation.qen: Compare cafés here and in Arab countries.
conversation.model: بَيْنَمَا يَشْرَبُ النَّاسُ هُنَا القَهْوَةَ بِسُرْعَةٍ قَبْلَ العَمَلِ، يَجْلِسُ النَّاسُ فِي المَقَاهِي العَرَبِيَّةِ سَاعَاتٍ يَتَحَدَّثُونَ وَيَلْعَبُونَ.
conversation.en: While people here drink coffee quickly before work, people in Arab cafés sit for hours talking and playing games.

conversation.q: صِفْ مُشْكِلَةً حَدَثَتْ لَكَ فِي مَطْعَمٍ.
conversation.qen: Describe a problem you had in a restaurant.
conversation.model: مَرَّةً طَلَبْتُ طَبَقًا نَبَاتِيًّا، فَأَحْضَرَ النَّادِلُ طَبَقًا بِاللَّحْمِ، فَشَرَحْتُ لَهُ بِأَدَبٍ، وَغَيَّرَهُ بِسُرْعَةٍ.
conversation.en: Once I ordered a vegetarian dish and the waiter brought one with meat; I explained politely and he changed it quickly.

conversation.q: هَلْ يَجِبُ أَنْ نَتْرُكَ إِكْرَامِيَّةً لِلنَّادِلِ؟
conversation.qen: Should we leave a tip for the waiter?
conversation.model: أَرَى أَنَّ الإِكْرَامِيَّةَ فِكْرَةٌ جَيِّدَةٌ إِذَا كَانَتِ الخِدْمَةُ مُمْتَازَةً، لِأَنَّ النُّدُلَ يَعْمَلُونَ سَاعَاتٍ طَوِيلَةً.
conversation.en: I think a tip is a good idea if the service is excellent, because waiters work long hours.

conversation.q: لَوْ فَتَحْتَ مَقْهًى، كَيْفَ تَجْعَلُهُ مُمَيَّزًا؟
conversation.qen: If you opened a café, how would you make it special?
conversation.model: لَوْ فَتَحْتُ مَقْهًى، لَجَعَلْتُهُ مَكَانًا هَادِئًا لِلْقِرَاءَةِ، وَلَقَدَّمْتُ مَشْرُوبَاتٍ صِحِّيَّةً بِأَسْعَارٍ رَخِيصَةٍ.
conversation.en: If I opened a café, I would make it a quiet place for reading and serve healthy drinks at low prices.
