Healthy, active — and what to avoid

roleplays.title: A health check with the school nurse

tasks.task: Say how many hours you sleep.
tasks.model: أَنَامُ ثَمَانِيَ سَاعَاتٍ فِي اللَّيْلِ.
tasks.en: I sleep eight hours a night.

tasks.task: Say what you eat for breakfast.
tasks.model: آكُلُ الشُّوفَانَ مَعَ المَوْزِ، وَأَشْرَبُ الحَلِيبَ.
tasks.en: I eat oats with banana, and I drink milk.

tasks.task: Say if and how often you exercise.
tasks.model: نَعَمْ، أُمَارِسُ كُرَةَ القَدَمِ مَرَّتَيْنِ فِي الأُسْبُوعِ.
tasks.en: Yes, I play football twice a week.

tasks.task: Say how much water you drink.
tasks.model: أَشْرَبُ خَمْسَةَ أَكْوَابٍ مِنَ المَاءِ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ.
tasks.en: I drink five glasses of water every day.

tasks.task: Answer the unexpected question.
tasks.model: لَا، آكُلُهَا أَحْيَانًا فَقَطْ، فِي نِهَايَةِ الأُسْبُوعِ.
tasks.en: No, I only eat them sometimes, at the weekend.

tasks.task: Give a reason for joining.
tasks.model: أُرِيدُ أَنْ أَكُونَ نَشِيطًا وَصِحِّيًّا أَكْثَرَ.
tasks.en: I want to be more active and healthy.

tasks.task: Say which sport you like.
tasks.model: أُحِبُّ السِّبَاحَةَ لِأَنَّهَا مُمْتِعَةٌ.
tasks.en: I like swimming because it is fun.

tasks.task: Say which days and times.
tasks.model: أَسْتَطِيعُ أَنْ آتِيَ يَوْمَ السَّبْتِ وَيَوْمَ الأَرْبِعَاءِ بَعْدَ المَدْرَسَةِ.
tasks.en: I can come on Saturday and Wednesday after school.

tasks.examiner: … يَجِبُ أَنْ تَأْكُلَ قَبْلَ التَّدْرِيبِ بِسَاعَتَيْنِ.
tasks.task: ASK what you should eat before training (the examiner then answers).
tasks.model: مَاذَا يَنْبَغِي أَنْ آكُلَ قَبْلَ التَّدْرِيبِ؟
tasks.en: What should I eat before training?

tasks.task: Answer the unexpected question.
tasks.model: لَا، لَيْسَ عِنْدِي أَيُّ مُشْكِلَةٍ، وَالحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ.
tasks.en: No, I have no problems, thank God.

roleplays.title: A friend who feels tired
roleplays.examiner: your friend who is always tired

tasks.task: Give one piece of advice about sleep.
tasks.model: يَجِبُ أَنْ تَنَامَ مُبَكِّرًا، ثَمَانِيَ سَاعَاتٍ عَلَى الأَقَلِّ.
tasks.en: You must sleep early, at least eight hours.

tasks.task: Advise him about the phone, with a reason.
tasks.model: يَنْبَغِي أَلَّا تَسْتَعْمِلَ الهَاتِفَ قَبْلَ النَّوْمِ، لِأَنَّ الضَّوْءَ يُبْعِدُ النَّوْمَ.
tasks.en: You should not use your phone before bed, because the light keeps sleep away.

tasks.task: Give advice about food (two things).
tasks.model: كُلِ الخُضَارَ وَالفَوَاكِهَ، وَتَجَنَّبِ الوَجَبَاتِ السَّرِيعَةَ وَالسُّكَّرَ.
tasks.en: Eat vegetables and fruit, and avoid fast food and sugar.

tasks.task: ASK what sport he does (the examiner then answers).
tasks.model: وَأَيَّ رِيَاضَةٍ تُمَارِسُ؟
tasks.en: And what sport do you do?

tasks.task: Answer the unexpected question (future).
tasks.model: نَعَمْ، سَآتِي مَعَكَ يَوْمَ السَّبْتِ، وَسَنَمْشِي سَاعَةً فِي الحَدِيقَةِ بَعْدَ ذٰلِكَ.
tasks.en: Yes, I will come with you on Saturday, and we will walk in the park for an hour afterwards.

roleplays.title: The school health campaign
roleplays.you: a student leading a health campaign

tasks.task: Explain the aim of the campaign.
tasks.model: نُرِيدُ أَنْ نُشَجِّعَ الطُّلَّابَ عَلَى الأَكْلِ الصِّحِّيِّ، لِكَيْ يَكُونُوا أَنْشَطَ فِي الدِّرَاسَةِ.
tasks.en: We want to encourage students to eat healthily, so that they are more active in their studies.

tasks.task: Say what you have done so far (past).
tasks.model: نَظَّمْنَا يَوْمًا لِلْفَوَاكِهِ فِي المَقْصَفِ، وَوَزَّعْنَا مَلْصَقَاتٍ عَنْ أَهَمِّيَّةِ المَاءِ.
tasks.en: We organised a fruit day in the canteen and handed out posters about the importance of water.

tasks.examiner: لِمَاذَا يَأْكُلُ الشَّبَابُ الوَجَبَاتِ السَّرِيعَةَ فِي رَأْيِكَ؟
tasks.task: Give an opinion with two reasons.
tasks.model: لِأَنَّهَا رَخِيصَةٌ وَسَرِيعَةٌ، وَلِأَنَّ الإِعْلَانَاتِ تُشَجِّعُهُمْ عَلَيْهَا كُلَّ يَوْمٍ.
tasks.en: Because it is cheap and quick, and because adverts encourage them every day.

tasks.examiner: هَلْ الرِّيَاضَةُ أَهَمُّ مِنَ الأَكْلِ الصِّحِّيِّ؟
tasks.task: Concede and give your view.
tasks.model: صَحِيحٌ أَنَّ الرِّيَاضَةَ مُهِمَّةٌ جِدًّا، غَيْرَ أَنَّهَا لَا تَكْفِي إِذَا كَانَ الطَّعَامُ غَيْرَ صِحِّيٍّ.
tasks.en: It is true that sport is very important, but it is not enough if the food is unhealthy.

tasks.examiner: لَوْ كُنْتَ مُدِيرَ المَدْرَسَةِ، مَاذَا تُغَيِّرُ؟
tasks.task: Answer the unexpected question (a conditional).
tasks.model: لَوْ كُنْتُ مُدِيرَ المَدْرَسَةِ، لَمَنَعْتُ المَشْرُوبَاتِ الغَازِيَّةَ، وَلَأَضَفْتُ حِصَّةَ رِيَاضَةٍ ثَالِثَةً.
tasks.en: If I were the head teacher, I would ban fizzy drinks and add a third PE lesson.

conversation.qen: Do you eat healthy food?
conversation.model: نَعَمْ، آكُلُ الخُضَارَ وَالفَوَاكِهَ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ.
conversation.en: Yes, I eat vegetables and fruit every day.

conversation.qen: How many hours do you sleep?
conversation.model: أَنَامُ سَبْعَ سَاعَاتٍ تَقْرِيبًا.
conversation.en: I sleep about seven hours.

conversation.qen: What is your favourite sport?
conversation.model: رِيَاضَتِي المُفَضَّلَةُ هِيَ كُرَةُ السَّلَّةِ.
conversation.en: My favourite sport is basketball.

conversation.qen: What do you usually drink?
conversation.model: أَشْرَبُ المَاءَ عَادَةً، وَأَحْيَانًا العَصِيرَ.
conversation.en: I usually drink water, and sometimes juice.

conversation.qen: Do you like fast food?
conversation.model: نَعَمْ، أُحِبُّهَا، لٰكِنْ لَا آكُلُهَا كَثِيرًا.
conversation.en: Yes, I like it, but I don’t eat it often.

conversation.qen: Describe a healthy day in your life.
conversation.model: أَسْتَيْقِظُ مُبَكِّرًا وَآكُلُ فُطُورًا صِحِّيًّا، ثُمَّ أَمْشِي إِلَى المَدْرَسَةِ، وَفِي المَسَاءِ أُمَارِسُ السِّبَاحَةَ.
conversation.en: I wake up early and eat a healthy breakfast, then walk to school, and in the evening I go swimming.

conversation.q: مَا العَادَةُ غَيْرُ الصِّحِّيَّةِ الَّتِي عِنْدَكَ؟
conversation.qen: What unhealthy habit do you have?
conversation.model: أَحْيَانًا أَسْهَرُ عَلَى الهَاتِفِ، لٰكِنِّي أُحَاوِلُ أَنْ أَنَامَ مُبَكِّرًا.
conversation.en: Sometimes I stay up on my phone, but I try to sleep early.

conversation.q: مَا نَصِيحَتُكَ لِطَالِبٍ لَا يَأْكُلُ الفُطُورَ؟
conversation.qen: What advice for a student who skips breakfast?
conversation.model: يَجِبُ أَنْ يَأْكُلَ الفُطُورَ، لِأَنَّهُ يُعْطِيهِ الطَّاقَةَ لِلتَّرْكِيزِ فِي الصَّفِّ.
conversation.en: He must eat breakfast, because it gives him energy to concentrate in class.

conversation.qen: Do you exercise with your family?
conversation.model: نَعَمْ، نَمْشِي مَعًا فِي الحَدِيقَةِ يَوْمَ الأَحَدِ، وَأَحْيَانًا نَرْكَبُ الدَّرَّاجَاتِ.
conversation.en: Yes, we walk together in the park on Sundays, and sometimes we ride bikes.

conversation.q: مَاذَا أَكَلْتَ أَمْسِ؟ هَلْ كَانَ صِحِّيًّا؟
conversation.qen: What did you eat yesterday? Was it healthy?
conversation.model: أَمْسِ أَكَلْتُ سَمَكًا مَعَ الخُضَارِ، وَكَانَ صِحِّيًّا وَلَذِيذًا.
conversation.en: Yesterday I ate fish with vegetables, and it was healthy and tasty.

conversation.q: هَلِ الشَّبَابُ اليَوْمَ أَقَلُّ صِحَّةً مِنَ المَاضِي؟
conversation.qen: Are young people less healthy than in the past?
conversation.starter: فِي المَاضِي كَانَ … أَمَّا اليَوْمَ فَيَجْلِسُونَ …
conversation.model: فِي المَاضِي كَانَ الشَّبَابُ يَلْعَبُونَ فِي الخَارِجِ أَكْثَرَ، أَمَّا اليَوْمَ فَيَجْلِسُونَ أَمَامَ الشَّاشَاتِ سَاعَاتٍ طَوِيلَةً.
conversation.en: In the past young people played outside more; today they sit in front of screens for hours.

conversation.q: مَا أَهَمُّ عَادَةٍ صِحِّيَّةٍ فِي رَأْيِكَ؟ لِمَاذَا؟
conversation.qen: What is the most important healthy habit?
conversation.model: أَعْتَقِدُ أَنَّ أَهَمَّ عَادَةٍ هِيَ النَّوْمُ الكَافِي، لِأَنَّهُ يُؤَثِّرُ فِي التَّرْكِيزِ وَالمِزَاجِ وَالصِّحَّةِ كُلِّهَا.
conversation.en: I think the most important habit is enough sleep, because it affects concentration, mood and all of our health.

conversation.qen: How did you change a bad habit?
conversation.model: كُنْتُ أَشْرَبُ المَشْرُوبَاتِ الغَازِيَّةَ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ، فَقَرَّرْتُ أَنْ أَشْرَبَ المَاءَ بَدَلًا مِنْهَا، وَالآنَ أَشْعُرُ بِنَشَاطٍ أَكْبَرَ.
conversation.en: I used to drink fizzy drinks every day, so I decided to drink water instead, and now I feel more energetic.

conversation.q: هَلْ يَجِبُ عَلَى المَدَارِسِ أَنْ تَمْنَعَ الوَجَبَاتِ السَّرِيعَةَ؟
conversation.qen: Should schools ban fast food?
conversation.model: صَحِيحٌ أَنَّ المَنْعَ يَحْمِي الطُّلَّابَ، غَيْرَ أَنَّ التَّوْعِيَةَ أَفْضَلُ، لِأَنَّ الطَّالِبَ يَجِبُ أَنْ يَخْتَارَ بِنَفْسِهِ.
conversation.en: It is true that a ban protects students, but education is better, because students must choose for themselves.

conversation.q: لَوْ كَانَ عِنْدَكَ شَهْرٌ لِتُحَسِّنَ صِحَّتَكَ، مَاذَا تَفْعَلُ؟
conversation.qen: If you had a month to improve your health, what would you do?
conversation.model: لَوْ كَانَ عِنْدِي شَهْرٌ، لَمَارَسْتُ الرِّيَاضَةَ كُلَّ صَبَاحٍ، وَلَتَعَلَّمْتُ طَبْخَ وَجَبَاتٍ صِحِّيَّةٍ.
conversation.en: If I had a month, I would exercise every morning and learn to cook healthy meals.

lessons.title: A Healthy Lifestyle
lessons.intro: Paper 3 practice in breakout rooms: talk about food, exercise and sleep, give and ask for advice (yajibu an · yanbaghī an), and justify healthy choices.

items.kind: you m. · you f. · he · she

tasks.examiner: مَدْرَسَةُ النُّورِ، صَبَاحُ الخَيْرِ. مَنْ مَعِي؟
tasks.task: Give your name and class.
tasks.model: صَبَاحُ النُّورِ، أَنَا سَامِي فِي الصَّفِّ العَاشِرِ.
tasks.en: Good morning, I am Sami in Year 10.

tasks.task: Say that you are ill and cannot come.
tasks.model: أَنَا مَرِيضٌ اليَوْمَ، وَلَا أَسْتَطِيعُ أَنْ آتِيَ إِلَى المَدْرَسَةِ.
tasks.en: I am ill today and I cannot come to school.

tasks.task: Say what hurts.
tasks.model: يُؤْلِمُنِي رَأْسِي وَبَطْنِي كَثِيرًا.
tasks.en: My head and my stomach hurt a lot.

tasks.task: Say which symptoms you have.
tasks.model: نَعَمْ، عِنْدِي حُمَّى وَسُعَالٌ أَيْضًا.
tasks.en: Yes, I have a fever and a cough too.

tasks.task: Answer the unexpected question.
tasks.model: مُنْذُ أَمْسِ فِي المَسَاءِ.
tasks.en: Since yesterday evening.

roleplays.title: At the school nurse after PE

tasks.task: Say what happened (past).
tasks.model: وَقَعْتُ فِي المَلْعَبِ أَثْنَاءَ المُبَارَاةِ.
tasks.en: I fell on the pitch during the match.

tasks.task: Say where it hurts (feminine body part).
tasks.model: تُؤْلِمُنِي رِجْلِي اليُسْرَى، وَيَدِي أَيْضًا.
tasks.en: My left leg hurts, and my hand too.

tasks.task: Say how well you can walk.
tasks.model: أَسْتَطِيعُ أَنْ أَمْشِيَ، لٰكِنْ بِبُطْءٍ، لِأَنَّ الأَلَمَ شَدِيدٌ.
tasks.en: I can walk, but slowly, because the pain is bad.

tasks.task: ASK if you should go home (the nurse then answers).
tasks.model: هَلْ يَجِبُ أَنْ أَرْجِعَ إِلَى البَيْتِ؟
tasks.en: Should I go back home?

tasks.task: Answer the unexpected question.
tasks.model: نَعَمْ، مِنْ فَضْلِكِ، اتَّصِلِي بِأُمِّي، رَقْمُهَا فِي دَفْتَرِي.
tasks.en: Yes please, call my mum; her number is in my notebook.

roleplays.title: Your friend missed the trip
roleplays.you: a student phoning a sick friend
roleplays.examiner: your friend who is ill at home

tasks.examiner: أَهْلًا! أَنَا فِي السَّرِيرِ مُنْذُ يَوْمَيْنِ.
tasks.task: Ask what is wrong, and show sympathy.
tasks.model: سَلَامَتُكَ يَا صَدِيقِي! مَاذَا عِنْدَكَ بِالضَّبْطِ؟
tasks.en: Get well soon, my friend! What exactly do you have?

tasks.examiner: عِنْدِي زُكَامٌ شَدِيدٌ. وَكَيْفَ كَانَتِ الرِّحْلَةُ؟
tasks.task: Describe the trip in two past sentences.
tasks.model: ذَهَبْنَا إِلَى المُتْحَفِ، وَكَانَتِ الرِّحْلَةُ رَائِعَةً، لٰكِنَّنَا افْتَقَدْنَاكَ كَثِيرًا.
tasks.en: We went to the museum and the trip was great, but we missed you a lot.

tasks.task: Give two pieces of advice.
tasks.model: يَجِبُ أَنْ تَشْرَبَ سَوَائِلَ دَافِئَةً، وَأَنْ تَرْتَاحَ كَثِيرًا.
tasks.en: You must drink warm drinks and rest a lot.

tasks.task: ASK when he will come back to school.
tasks.model: إِذَنْ، مَتَى سَتَرْجِعُ إِلَى المَدْرَسَةِ؟
tasks.en: So when will you come back to school?

tasks.task: Answer the unexpected question.
tasks.model: طَبْعًا، سَأُرْسِلُ لَكَ الوَاجِبَ وَصُوَرَ الرِّحْلَةِ اللَّيْلَةَ.
tasks.en: Of course, I will send you the homework and the trip photos tonight.

tasks.task: Say when and how it started (past).
tasks.model: بَدَأَتْ قَبْلَ ثَلَاثَةِ أَيَّامٍ، عِنْدَمَا رَجَعْتُ مِنَ المُبَارَاةِ مُبْتَلًّا بِالمَطَرِ.
tasks.en: They started three days ago, when I came back from the match soaked by the rain.

tasks.task: Describe the symptoms in detail.
tasks.model: عِنْدِي صُدَاعٌ وَسُعَالٌ، وَيَزْدَادُ السُّعَالُ فِي اللَّيْلِ، فَلَا أَسْتَطِيعُ أَنْ أَنَامَ.
tasks.en: I have a headache and a cough, and the cough gets worse at night, so I can’t sleep.

tasks.task: Say what you tried and whether it helped.
tasks.model: أَخَذْتُ دَوَاءً لِلصُّدَاعِ، لٰكِنَّهُ لَمْ يُسَاعِدْنِي كَثِيرًا.
tasks.en: I took a headache tablet, but it did not help me much.

tasks.task: Compare with a past illness.
tasks.model: نَعَمْ، فِي الشِّتَاءِ المَاضِي، لٰكِنَّ الأَعْرَاضَ هٰذِهِ المَرَّةَ أَشَدُّ وَأَطْوَلُ.
tasks.en: Yes, last winter, but this time the symptoms are worse and longer.

tasks.examiner: لَوْ أَعْطَيْتُكَ إِجَازَةً أُسْبُوعًا، مَاذَا سَتَفْعَلُ؟
tasks.task: Answer the unexpected question (rest + school work).
tasks.model: سَأَرْتَاحُ فِي البَيْتِ، لٰكِنْ يَجِبُ أَنْ أُرَاجِعَ دُرُوسِي، لِأَنَّ الامْتِحَانَاتِ قَرِيبَةٌ.
tasks.en: I will rest at home, but I must revise, because the exams are close.

conversation.qen: How is your health today?
conversation.model: صِحَّتِي جَيِّدَةٌ اليَوْمَ، وَالحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ.
conversation.en: My health is good today, thank God.

conversation.qen: When were you last ill?
conversation.model: كُنْتُ مَرِيضًا فِي الشَّهْرِ المَاضِي، وَكَانَ عِنْدِي زُكَامٌ.
conversation.en: I was ill last month; I had a cold.

conversation.qen: What do you do when you have a headache?
conversation.model: عِنْدَمَا يُؤْلِمُنِي رَأْسِي، أَشْرَبُ المَاءَ وَأَنَامُ قَلِيلًا.
conversation.en: When my head hurts, I drink water and sleep a little.

conversation.qen: Do you go to the doctor often?
conversation.model: لَا، أَذْهَبُ إِلَى الطَّبِيبِ مَرَّةً فِي السَّنَةِ فَقَطْ.
conversation.en: No, I only go to the doctor once a year.

conversation.qen: Who looks after you when you are ill?
conversation.model: تَعْتَنِي بِي أُمِّي، وَتَطْبُخُ لِي الشُّورْبَةَ.
conversation.en: My mum looks after me and makes me soup.

conversation.q: صِفْ آخِرَ مَرَّةٍ كُنْتَ فِيهَا مَرِيضًا.
conversation.qen: Describe the last time you were ill.
conversation.model: فِي الشِّتَاءِ كَانَ عِنْدِي حُمَّى وَسُعَالٌ، وَبَقِيتُ فِي البَيْتِ ثَلَاثَةَ أَيَّامٍ.
conversation.en: In winter I had a fever and a cough, and I stayed at home for three days.

conversation.q: هَلْ جُرِحْتَ فِي الرِّيَاضَةِ مِنْ قَبْلُ؟
conversation.qen: Have you ever been injured in sport?
conversation.model: نَعَمْ، مَرَّةً وَقَعْتُ فِي مُبَارَاةِ كُرَةِ القَدَمِ، فَآلَمَتْنِي رِجْلِي أُسْبُوعَيْنِ.
conversation.en: Yes, once I fell in a football match, so my leg hurt for two weeks.

conversation.q: مَاذَا يَجِبُ أَنْ يَفْعَلَ الطَّالِبُ المَرِيضُ؟
conversation.qen: What should an ill student do?
conversation.model: يَجِبُ أَنْ يَبْقَى فِي البَيْتِ وَيَرْتَاحَ، وَأَلَّا يَأْتِيَ إِلَى المَدْرَسَةِ حَتَّى لَا يُعْدِيَ زُمَلَاءَهُ.
conversation.en: He must stay at home and rest, and not come to school so that he doesn’t infect his classmates.

conversation.qen: What illnesses are common in winter?
conversation.model: فِي الشِّتَاءِ يُصَابُ كَثِيرٌ مِنَ النَّاسِ بِالزُّكَامِ وَالسُّعَالِ، لِأَنَّ الجَوَّ بَارِدٌ.
conversation.en: In winter many people catch colds and coughs, because the weather is cold.

conversation.qen: How do you feel when you are ill?
conversation.model: أَشْعُرُ بِالتَّعَبِ وَالمَلَلِ، وَلَا أَسْتَطِيعُ أَنْ أُرَكِّزَ عَلَى أَيِّ شَيْءٍ.
conversation.en: I feel tired and bored, and I can’t concentrate on anything.

conversation.qen: Is prevention more important than cure?
conversation.model: أَعْتَقِدُ أَنَّ الوِقَايَةَ أَهَمُّ، لِأَنَّ غَسْلَ اليَدَيْنِ وَالنَّوْمَ الجَيِّدَ يَحْمِيَانِنَا مِنْ أَمْرَاضٍ كَثِيرَةٍ.
conversation.en: I think prevention is more important, because washing our hands and good sleep protect us from many illnesses.

conversation.q: هَلْ يَذْهَبُ الطُّلَّابُ إِلَى المَدْرَسَةِ وَهُمْ مَرْضَى؟ لِمَاذَا؟
conversation.qen: Do students go to school while ill? Why?
conversation.model: نَعَمْ، بَعْضُهُمْ يَأْتُونَ وَهُمْ مَرْضَى خَوْفًا مِنْ أَنْ تَفُوتَهُمُ الدُّرُوسُ، وَهٰذَا يَنْشُرُ المَرَضَ.
conversation.en: Yes, some come while ill for fear of missing lessons, and this spreads the illness.

conversation.qen: How has people’s attention to health changed?
conversation.starter: فِي المَاضِي كَانَ … أَمَّا الآنَ فَيَبْحَثُونَ …
conversation.model: فِي المَاضِي كَانَ النَّاسُ يَذْهَبُونَ إِلَى الطَّبِيبِ مُتَأَخِّرِينَ، أَمَّا الآنَ فَيَبْحَثُونَ عَنِ الأَعْرَاضِ فِي الإِنْتَرْنِتِ أَوَّلًا.
conversation.en: In the past people went to the doctor late; now they look up their symptoms online first.

conversation.q: هَلِ البَحْثُ عَنِ الأَعْرَاضِ فِي الإِنْتَرْنِتِ مُفِيدٌ؟
conversation.qen: Is looking up symptoms online useful?
conversation.model: صَحِيحٌ أَنَّهُ سَرِيعٌ وَسَهْلٌ، غَيْرَ أَنَّ المَعْلُومَاتِ أَحْيَانًا خَاطِئَةٌ وَتُخِيفُ المَرِيضَ بِلَا سَبَبٍ.
conversation.en: It is true that it is quick and easy, but the information is sometimes wrong and frightens the patient for no reason.

conversation.q: لَوْ كُنْتَ طَبِيبًا، مَاذَا تَنْصَحُ الشَّبَابَ؟
conversation.qen: If you were a doctor, what would you advise young people?
conversation.model: لَوْ كُنْتُ طَبِيبًا، لَنَصَحْتُهُمْ بِأَنْ يَنَامُوا جَيِّدًا، وَأَنْ يَتْرُكُوا الهَاتِفَ سَاعَةً قَبْلَ النَّوْمِ.
conversation.en: If I were a doctor, I would advise them to sleep well and to put their phone down an hour before bed.

lessons.title: Body and Health Problems
lessons.intro: Paper 3 practice in breakout rooms: say what hurts (yuʾlimunī ra’sī), describe symptoms with ʿindī, say how long (mundhu) and talk about being ill in the past.

bank.title: At the doctor and the pharmacy

items.en: I advise you to … (+ verb in -a)

tasks.task: Ask for an appointment.
tasks.model: صَبَاحُ الخَيْرِ، هَلْ يُمْكِنُ أَنْ أَحْجِزَ مَوْعِدًا مَعَ الطَّبِيبِ؟
tasks.en: Good morning, could I book an appointment with the doctor?

tasks.task: Give your name and age.
tasks.model: اسْمِي يُوسُفُ، وَعُمْرِي خَمْسَ عَشْرَةَ سَنَةً.
tasks.en: My name is Yusuf and I am fifteen.

tasks.task: Say what the problem is.
tasks.model: عِنْدِي حُمَّى، وَيُؤْلِمُنِي حَلْقِي مُنْذُ ثَلَاثَةِ أَيَّامٍ.
tasks.en: I have a fever and my throat has hurt for three days.

tasks.examiner: عِنْدَنَا مَوْعِدٌ غَدًا فِي العَاشِرَةِ أَوْ فِي الرَّابِعَةِ.
tasks.task: Choose a time and say why.
tasks.model: أُفَضِّلُ السَّاعَةَ الرَّابِعَةَ، لِأَنَّ عِنْدِي امْتِحَانًا فِي الصَّبَاحِ.
tasks.en: I prefer four o’clock, because I have an exam in the morning.

tasks.examiner: هَلْ عِنْدَكَ حَسَاسِيَّةٌ مِنْ أَيِّ دَوَاءٍ؟
tasks.task: Answer the unexpected question.
tasks.model: لَا، لَيْسَ عِنْدِي حَسَاسِيَّةٌ مِنْ أَيِّ دَوَاءٍ.
tasks.en: No, I am not allergic to any medicine.

tasks.task: Say what you need and for whom.
tasks.model: أُرِيدُ دَوَاءً لِلسُّعَالِ لِأَخِي الصَّغِيرِ، مِنْ فَضْلِكِ.
tasks.en: I would like some cough medicine for my little brother, please.

tasks.task: Say his age.
tasks.model: عُمْرُهُ سَبْعُ سَنَوَاتٍ.
tasks.en: He is seven years old.

tasks.task: ASK how often he should take it.
tasks.model: كَمْ مَرَّةً يَجِبُ أَنْ يَأْخُذَهُ فِي اليَوْمِ؟
tasks.en: How many times a day should he take it?

tasks.examiner: مِلْعَقَةً ثَلَاثَ مَرَّاتٍ فِي اليَوْمِ، بَعْدَ الأَكْلِ.
tasks.task: Repeat the instructions to check.
tasks.model: إِذَنْ، مِلْعَقَةً وَاحِدَةً ثَلَاثَ مَرَّاتٍ فِي اليَوْمِ، بَعْدَ الأَكْلِ. شُكْرًا.
tasks.en: So, one spoonful three times a day, after food. Thank you.

tasks.task: Answer the unexpected question.
tasks.model: لَا، شُكْرًا. بِكَمْ هٰذَا الشَّرَابُ؟
tasks.en: No, thank you. How much is this syrup?

tasks.task: Describe two symptoms and how long.
tasks.model: عِنْدِي صُدَاعٌ شَدِيدٌ وَدُوَارٌ مُنْذُ يَوْمِ الأَحَدِ.
tasks.en: I have had a bad headache and dizziness since Sunday.

tasks.examiner: هَلْ تَنَامُ جَيِّدًا؟ وَكَمْ سَاعَةً تَدْرُسُ؟
tasks.task: Explain your routine (a likely cause).
tasks.model: لَا، أَدْرُسُ حَتَّى مُنْتَصَفِ اللَّيْلِ لِلِامْتِحَانَاتِ، وَأَنَامُ خَمْسَ سَاعَاتٍ فَقَطْ.
tasks.en: No, I study until midnight for the exams and only sleep five hours.

tasks.task: ASK what else you should do.
tasks.model: وَمَاذَا يَجِبُ أَنْ أَفْعَلَ أَيْضًا؟ هَلْ أَحْتَاجُ إِلَى دَوَاءٍ؟
tasks.en: And what else should I do? Do I need medicine?

tasks.examiner: اشْرَبِ المَاءَ، وَخُذْ هٰذِهِ الحُبُوبَ عِنْدَ الصُّدَاعِ فَقَطْ.
tasks.task: Repeat the advice and say how you will follow it.
tasks.model: حَسَنًا، سَأَشْرَبُ المَاءَ كَثِيرًا، وَسَآخُذُ الحُبُوبَ عِنْدَ الصُّدَاعِ فَقَطْ.
tasks.en: OK, I will drink lots of water and take the tablets only when I have a headache.

tasks.examiner: هَلْ تُمَارِسُ أَيَّ رِيَاضَةٍ هٰذِهِ الأَيَّامَ؟
tasks.task: Answer the unexpected question (past + present).
tasks.model: كُنْتُ أَلْعَبُ التِّنِسَ، لٰكِنِّي تَوَقَّفْتُ بِسَبَبِ الدِّرَاسَةِ.
tasks.en: I used to play tennis, but I stopped because of studying.

tasks.examiner: أَهْلًا بِكَ فِي البَرْنَامَجِ. مَا سُؤَالُكَ؟
tasks.task: Explain your problem and its effect.
tasks.model: أَشْعُرُ بِالتَّعَبِ طُولَ الوَقْتِ، مِمَّا يُؤَثِّرُ فِي دِرَاسَتِي وَمِزَاجِي.
tasks.en: I feel tired all the time, which affects my studies and my mood.

tasks.task: Say what you have tried (past) and the result.
tasks.model: جَرَّبْتُ أَنْ أَشْرَبَ القَهْوَةَ، لٰكِنَّهَا جَعَلَتْنِي أَسْهَرُ أَكْثَرَ.
tasks.en: I tried drinking coffee, but it made me stay up even later.

tasks.task: Answer and give your opinion with a reason.
tasks.model: لَا، لِأَنِّي أَعْتَقِدُ أَنَّ أَخْذَ الدَّوَاءِ بِدُونِ اسْتِشَارَةِ الطَّبِيبِ خَطِيرٌ.
tasks.en: No, because I believe taking medicine without consulting a doctor is dangerous.

tasks.examiner: أَنْصَحُكَ بِأَنْ تُنَظِّمَ نَوْمَكَ وَتَتْرُكَ القَهْوَةَ.
tasks.task: Concede, then ask a follow-up question.
tasks.model: صَحِيحٌ أَنَّ النَّوْمَ مُهِمٌّ، غَيْرَ أَنَّ الوَاجِبَاتِ كَثِيرَةٌ، فَكَيْفَ أُنَظِّمُ وَقْتِي؟
tasks.en: It is true that sleep is important, but there is a lot of homework, so how do I organise my time?

tasks.examiner: لَوْ كُنْتَ وَزِيرَ الصِّحَّةِ، مَاذَا تَفْعَلُ لِلشَّبَابِ؟
tasks.task: Answer the unexpected question (a conditional).
tasks.model: لَوْ كُنْتُ وَزِيرَ الصِّحَّةِ، لَفَتَحْتُ عِيَادَةً مَجَّانِيَّةً لِلشَّبَابِ فِي كُلِّ مَدْرَسَةٍ.
tasks.en: If I were health minister, I would open a free youth clinic in every school.

conversation.q: مَتَى ذَهَبْتَ إِلَى الطَّبِيبِ آخِرَ مَرَّةٍ؟
conversation.qen: When did you last go to the doctor?
conversation.model: ذَهَبْتُ إِلَى الطَّبِيبِ فِي الشَّهْرِ المَاضِي.
conversation.en: I went to the doctor last month.

conversation.qen: Where is the nearest pharmacy to your home?
conversation.model: الصَّيْدَلِيَّةُ فِي شَارِعِنَا، بِجَانِبِ المَخْبَزِ.
conversation.en: The pharmacy is in our street, next to the bakery.

conversation.qen: Do you like taking medicine?
conversation.model: لَا، لَا أُحِبُّ الدَّوَاءَ، لِأَنَّ طَعْمَهُ مُرٌّ.
conversation.en: No, I don’t like medicine because it tastes bitter.

conversation.qen: What do you do when you have a cold?
conversation.model: أَشْرَبُ الشَّايَ بِاللَّيْمُونِ، وَأَرْتَاحُ فِي البَيْتِ.
conversation.en: I drink tea with lemon and rest at home.

conversation.qen: Would you like to be a doctor?
conversation.model: نَعَمْ، أُرِيدُ أَنْ أَكُونَ طَبِيبًا، لِأَنِّي أُحِبُّ أَنْ أُسَاعِدَ النَّاسَ.
conversation.en: Yes, I want to be a doctor because I like helping people.

conversation.qen: Describe your last visit to the doctor.
conversation.model: ذَهَبْتُ لِأَنَّ أُذُنِي كَانَتْ تُؤْلِمُنِي، فَفَحَصَنِي الطَّبِيبُ، وَنَصَحَنِي بِأَنْ أَسْتَعْمِلَ قَطْرَةً أُسْبُوعًا.
conversation.en: I went because my ear hurt; the doctor examined me and advised me to use drops for a week.

conversation.qen: What would you advise a friend with a cold?
conversation.model: أَنْصَحُهُ بِأَنْ يَرْتَاحَ وَيَشْرَبَ سَوَائِلَ دَافِئَةً، وَأَلَّا يَخْرُجَ فِي البَرْدِ.
conversation.en: I advise him to rest and drink warm fluids, and not to go out in the cold.

conversation.qen: Do you read medicine instructions? Why?
conversation.model: نَعَمْ، أَقْرَؤُهَا دَائِمًا، لِأَنَّ بَعْضَ الأَدْوِيَةِ يَجِبُ أَنْ نَأْخُذَهَا بَعْدَ الأَكْلِ.
conversation.en: Yes, I always read them, because some medicines must be taken after food.

conversation.q: مَا رَأْيُكَ فِي الطِّبِّ الشَّعْبِيِّ، مِثْلِ العَسَلِ وَالأَعْشَابِ؟
conversation.qen: What do you think of home remedies like honey and herbs?
conversation.model: أَعْتَقِدُ أَنَّ العَسَلَ مُفِيدٌ لِلْحَلْقِ، لٰكِنْ يَجِبُ أَنْ نَذْهَبَ إِلَى الطَّبِيبِ إِذَا كَانَ المَرَضُ شَدِيدًا.
conversation.en: I think honey is good for the throat, but we must see a doctor if the illness is serious.

conversation.q: مَنْ فِي أُسْرَتِكَ يَعْمَلُ فِي مَجَالِ الصِّحَّةِ؟
conversation.qen: Who in your family works in health?
conversation.model: خَالَتِي مُمَرِّضَةٌ، وَتَعْمَلُ فِي مُسْتَشْفًى كَبِيرٍ، وَهِيَ تَنْصَحُنَا دَائِمًا بِالنَّوْمِ المُبَكِّرِ.
conversation.en: My aunt is a nurse; she works in a big hospital and always advises us to sleep early.

conversation.q: هَلْ يَأْخُذُ النَّاسُ أَدْوِيَةً أَكْثَرَ مِنَ اللَّازِمِ؟
conversation.qen: Do people take more medicine than necessary?
conversation.model: نَعَمْ، فِي رَأْيِي يَأْخُذُ كَثِيرٌ مِنَ النَّاسِ المُسَكِّنَاتِ عِنْدَ أَيِّ أَلَمٍ بَسِيطٍ، بَدَلًا مِنْ أَنْ يَرْتَاحُوا.
conversation.en: Yes, I think many people take painkillers for any small pain instead of resting.

conversation.q: مَا الفَرْقُ بَيْنَ الطَّبِيبِ وَالصَّيْدَلِيِّ فِي رَأْيِكَ؟
conversation.qen: What is the difference between a doctor and a pharmacist?
conversation.model: الطَّبِيبُ يَفْحَصُ المَرِيضَ وَيَكْتُبُ الوَصْفَةَ، أَمَّا الصَّيْدَلِيُّ فَيَشْرَحُ كَيْفَ نَأْخُذُ الدَّوَاءَ.
conversation.en: The doctor examines the patient and writes the prescription; the pharmacist explains how to take the medicine.

conversation.q: هَلِ الاسْتِشَارَةُ الطِّبِّيَّةُ عَبْرَ الإِنْتَرْنِتِ فِكْرَةٌ جَيِّدَةٌ؟
conversation.qen: Are online medical consultations a good idea?
conversation.model: صَحِيحٌ أَنَّهَا سَرِيعَةٌ وَتُوَفِّرُ الوَقْتَ، غَيْرَ أَنَّ الطَّبِيبَ لَا يَسْتَطِيعُ أَنْ يَفْحَصَ المَرِيضَ بِنَفْسِهِ.
conversation.en: It is true they are quick and save time, but the doctor cannot examine the patient in person.

conversation.q: كَيْفَ تَغَيَّرَتْ خِدْمَاتُ الصِّحَّةِ مُنْذُ أَيَّامِ أَجْدَادِكَ؟
conversation.qen: How have health services changed since your grandparents’ day?
conversation.starter: فِي أَيَّامِ جَدِّي كَانَ … أَمَّا اليَوْمَ فَهُنَاكَ …
conversation.model: فِي أَيَّامِ جَدِّي كَانَ النَّاسُ يَمْشُونَ سَاعَاتٍ إِلَى أَقْرَبِ طَبِيبٍ، أَمَّا اليَوْمَ فَهُنَاكَ عِيَادَةٌ فِي كُلِّ حَيٍّ.
conversation.en: In my grandfather’s day people walked for hours to the nearest doctor; today there is a clinic in every neighbourhood.

conversation.q: لَوْ أَصْبَحْتَ طَبِيبًا، أَيْنَ تُحِبُّ أَنْ تَعْمَلَ؟
conversation.qen: If you became a doctor, where would you like to work?
conversation.model: لَوْ أَصْبَحْتُ طَبِيبًا، لَعَمِلْتُ فِي قَرْيَةٍ بَعِيدَةٍ، لِأَنَّ أَهْلَهَا يَحْتَاجُونَ إِلَى الأَطِبَّاءِ أَكْثَرَ مِنْ غَيْرِهِمْ.
conversation.en: If I became a doctor, I would work in a remote village, because its people need doctors more than others.

lessons.title: Doctor and Pharmacy
lessons.intro: Paper 3 practice in breakout rooms: make an appointment, explain a problem to a doctor or pharmacist, ask for and give advice (anṣaḥuka an …), and understand medicine instructions.

roleplays.title: How do you get to school?

tasks.task: Say how you travel to school.
tasks.model: أَذْهَبُ إِلَى المَدْرَسَةِ بِالحَافِلَةِ.
tasks.en: I go to school by bus.

tasks.task: Say what time you leave home.
tasks.model: أَخْرُجُ مِنَ البَيْتِ فِي السَّاعَةِ السَّابِعَةِ وَالرُّبْعِ.
tasks.en: I leave home at quarter past seven.

tasks.task: Say how long the journey takes.
tasks.model: تَسْتَغْرِقُ الرِّحْلَةُ عِشْرِينَ دَقِيقَةً تَقْرِيبًا.
tasks.en: The journey takes about twenty minutes.

tasks.task: Say who you travel with.
tasks.model: أَذْهَبُ مَعَ أَخِي وَصَدِيقِي سَامِرٍ.
tasks.en: I go with my brother and my friend Samer.

tasks.task: Answer the unexpected question.
tasks.model: نَعَمْ، أُحِبُّهَا لِأَنَّهَا رَخِيصَةٌ، لٰكِنَّهَا مُزْدَحِمَةٌ أَحْيَانًا.
tasks.en: Yes, I like it because it is cheap, but it is sometimes crowded.

tasks.task: Say where you want to go.
tasks.model: أُرِيدُ تَذْكِرَةً إِلَى الإِسْكَنْدَرِيَّةِ، مِنْ فَضْلِكَ.
tasks.en: I would like a ticket to Alexandria, please.

tasks.task: Choose the type of ticket.
tasks.model: ذَهَابٌ وَعَوْدَةٌ، لِأَنِّي سَأَرْجِعُ يَوْمَ الجُمُعَةِ.
tasks.en: Return, because I will come back on Friday.

tasks.examiner: هُنَاكَ قِطَارٌ فِي التَّاسِعَةِ وَقِطَارٌ فِي الحَادِيَةَ عَشْرَةَ.
tasks.task: ASK which train is faster.
tasks.model: أَيُّ قِطَارٍ أَسْرَعُ، مِنْ فَضْلِكَ؟
tasks.en: Which train is faster, please?

tasks.task: Choose the train and ask the price.
tasks.model: سَآخُذُ قِطَارَ التَّاسِعَةِ إِذَنْ. بِكَمِ التَّذْكِرَةُ؟
tasks.en: I’ll take the nine o’clock train then. How much is the ticket?

tasks.task: Answer the unexpected question.
tasks.model: بِالبِطَاقَةِ، مِنْ فَضْلِكَ.
tasks.en: By card, please.

tasks.task: Politely ask the way to the museum.
tasks.model: نَعَمْ، لَوْ سَمَحْتَ، كَيْفَ أَصِلُ إِلَى المُتْحَفِ الوَطَنِيِّ؟
tasks.en: Yes, excuse me, how do I get to the National Museum?

tasks.examiner: اذْهَبْ إِلَى الأَمَامِ، ثُمَّ انْعَطِفْ يَمِينًا عِنْدَ البَنْكِ.
tasks.task: Repeat the directions to check.
tasks.model: إِذَنْ، أَذْهَبُ إِلَى الأَمَامِ، ثُمَّ أَنْعَطِفُ يَمِينًا عِنْدَ البَنْكِ. صَحِيحٌ؟
tasks.en: So I go straight on, then turn right at the bank. Is that right?

tasks.task: ASK if it is far, and if you should walk or take a bus.
tasks.help: هَلْ هُوَ بَعِيدٌ؟ هَلْ أَمْشِي أَمْ …؟
tasks.model: هَلْ هُوَ بَعِيدٌ؟ هَلْ أَمْشِي أَمْ آخُذُ الحَافِلَةَ؟
tasks.en: Is it far? Should I walk or take the bus?

tasks.examiner: عَشْرُ دَقَائِقَ مَشْيًا، أَوْ مَحَطَّتَانِ بِالحَافِلَةِ.
tasks.task: Decide and give a reason (comparison).
tasks.model: سَأَمْشِي، لِأَنَّ الجَوَّ جَمِيلٌ، وَالمَشْيُ أَرْخَصُ مِنَ الحَافِلَةِ.
tasks.en: I will walk, because the weather is nice and walking is cheaper than the bus.

tasks.examiner: مِنْ أَيْنَ أَنْتَ؟ وَكَيْفَ وَصَلْتَ إِلَى هُنَا؟
tasks.task: Answer the unexpected question (past).
tasks.model: أَنَا مِنْ لَنْدَنَ، وَوَصَلْتُ أَمْسِ بِالطَّائِرَةِ، ثُمَّ رَكِبْتُ القِطَارَ إِلَى وَسَطِ المَدِينَةِ.
tasks.en: I am from London; I arrived yesterday by plane, then took the train to the city centre.

tasks.examiner: مَا رَأْيُكَ فِي المُوَاصَلَاتِ العَامَّةِ فِي مَدِينَتِكَ؟
tasks.task: Give an opinion with a contrast.
tasks.model: الحَافِلَاتُ رَخِيصَةٌ لٰكِنَّهَا بَطِيئَةٌ، أَمَّا القِطَارُ فَأَسْرَعُ بِكَثِيرٍ، غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ غَالٍ.
tasks.en: The buses are cheap but slow; the train is much faster, but it is expensive.

tasks.examiner: هَلْ تَغَيَّرَتِ المُوَاصَلَاتُ فِي السَّنَوَاتِ الأَخِيرَةِ؟
tasks.task: Compare past and present.
tasks.model: قَبْلَ خَمْسِ سَنَوَاتٍ كَانَتِ الحَافِلَةُ تَأْتِي كُلَّ سَاعَةٍ، أَمَّا الآنَ فَتَأْتِي كُلَّ عَشْرِ دَقَائِقَ.
tasks.en: Five years ago the bus came every hour; now it comes every ten minutes.

tasks.examiner: لِمَاذَا يُفَضِّلُ النَّاسُ السَّيَّارَةَ فِي رَأْيِكَ؟
tasks.task: Give two reasons.
tasks.model: لِأَنَّهَا مُرِيحَةٌ وَتَصِلُ إِلَى كُلِّ مَكَانٍ، وَلِأَنَّ الحَافِلَاتِ لَا تَعْمَلُ فِي اللَّيْلِ.
tasks.en: Because it is comfortable and reaches everywhere, and because the buses don’t run at night.

tasks.examiner: هَلْ يَجِبُ أَنْ تَكُونَ المُوَاصَلَاتُ مَجَّانِيَّةً لِلطُّلَّابِ؟
tasks.task: Concede and give your view.
tasks.model: صَحِيحٌ أَنَّ ذٰلِكَ مُكْلِفٌ لِلْبَلَدِيَّةِ، غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ يُقَلِّلُ عَدَدَ السَّيَّارَاتِ وَالتَّلَوُّثَ.
tasks.en: It is true that it is costly for the council, but it reduces the number of cars and pollution.

tasks.examiner: لَوْ كَانَ عِنْدَكَ مِلْيُونُ دِينَارٍ لِلْمُوَاصَلَاتِ، مَاذَا تَفْعَلُ؟
tasks.task: Answer the unexpected question (a conditional).
tasks.model: لَوْ كَانَ عِنْدِي مِلْيُونُ دِينَارٍ، لَبَنَيْتُ طُرُقًا آمِنَةً لِلدَّرَّاجَاتِ حَوْلَ المَدَارِسِ.
tasks.en: If I had a million dinars, I would build safe cycle lanes around schools.

conversation.qen: How do you get to school?
conversation.model: أَمْشِي إِلَى المَدْرَسَةِ، لِأَنَّهَا قَرِيبَةٌ مِنْ بَيْتِي.
conversation.en: I walk to school, because it is near my house.

conversation.qen: How many minutes does the journey take?
conversation.model: تَسْتَغْرِقُ الرِّحْلَةُ رُبْعَ سَاعَةٍ فَقَطْ.
conversation.en: The journey takes only a quarter of an hour.

conversation.qen: What is your favourite means of transport?
conversation.model: أُفَضِّلُ القِطَارَ، لِأَنَّهُ سَرِيعٌ وَمُرِيحٌ.
conversation.en: I prefer the train, because it is fast and comfortable.

conversation.qen: Do you have a bike?
conversation.model: نَعَمْ، عِنْدِي دَرَّاجَةٌ زَرْقَاءُ، وَأَرْكَبُهَا فِي نِهَايَةِ الأُسْبُوعِ.
conversation.en: Yes, I have a blue bike and I ride it at the weekend.

conversation.qen: How does your father go to work?
conversation.model: يَذْهَبُ أَبِي إِلَى العَمَلِ بِالسَّيَّارَةِ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ.
conversation.en: My father goes to work by car every day.

conversation.qen: Compare the bus and the car.
conversation.model: الحَافِلَةُ أَرْخَصُ مِنَ السَّيَّارَةِ، لٰكِنَّ السَّيَّارَةَ أَسْرَعُ وَأَكْثَرُ رَاحَةً.
conversation.en: The bus is cheaper than the car, but the car is faster and more comfortable.

conversation.q: صِفْ رِحْلَةً قُمْتَ بِهَا بِالقِطَارِ أَوِ الطَّائِرَةِ.
conversation.qen: Describe a journey you made by train or plane.
conversation.model: فِي الصَّيْفِ سَافَرْتُ بِالقِطَارِ إِلَى أَدِنْبَرَةَ، وَاسْتَغْرَقَتِ الرِّحْلَةُ أَرْبَعَ سَاعَاتٍ، وَكَانَتِ المَنَاظِرُ جَمِيلَةً.
conversation.en: In the summer I travelled by train to Edinburgh; it took four hours and the views were beautiful.

conversation.q: مَا المُشْكِلَاتُ فِي المُوَاصَلَاتِ فِي مَدِينَتِكَ؟
conversation.qen: What are the transport problems in your town?
conversation.model: المُشْكِلَةُ الكُبْرَى هِيَ الازْدِحَامُ، خُصُوصًا فِي الصَّبَاحِ، فَأَحْيَانًا أَصِلُ مُتَأَخِّرًا.
conversation.en: The biggest problem is traffic, especially in the morning, so I sometimes arrive late.

conversation.q: كَيْفَ تَصِفُ الطَّرِيقَ مِنْ بَيْتِكَ إِلَى المَدْرَسَةِ؟
conversation.qen: Describe the route from your home to school.
conversation.model: أَخْرُجُ مِنَ البَيْتِ، وَأَمْشِي إِلَى الأَمَامِ، ثُمَّ أَنْعَطِفُ يَسَارًا عِنْدَ المَسْجِدِ، وَالمَدْرَسَةُ عَلَى اليَمِينِ.
conversation.en: I leave home, walk straight on, then turn left at the mosque; the school is on the right.

conversation.qen: Will you buy a car in the future?
conversation.model: لَا أَظُنُّ، سَأَسْتَعْمِلُ القِطَارَ وَالدَّرَّاجَةَ، لِأَنَّهُمَا أَفْضَلُ لِلْبِيئَةِ.
conversation.en: I don’t think so; I will use the train and the bike, because they are better for the environment.

conversation.q: هَلِ المُوَاصَلَاتُ العَامَّةُ أَفْضَلُ مِنَ السَّيَّارَاتِ الخَاصَّةِ؟
conversation.qen: Is public transport better than private cars?
conversation.model: أَعْتَقِدُ أَنَّ المُوَاصَلَاتِ العَامَّةَ أَفْضَلُ، لِأَنَّ حَافِلَةً وَاحِدَةً تَنْقُلُ خَمْسِينَ شَخْصًا بَدَلًا مِنْ خَمْسِينَ سَيَّارَةً.
conversation.en: I think public transport is better, because one bus carries fifty people instead of fifty cars.

conversation.q: كَيْفَ كَانَ النَّاسُ يُسَافِرُونَ فِي أَيَّامِ أَجْدَادِكَ؟
conversation.qen: How did people travel in your grandparents’ day?
conversation.starter: كَانَ جَدِّي يُسَافِرُ … أَمَّا اليَوْمَ فَنَقْطَعُ …
conversation.model: كَانَ جَدِّي يُسَافِرُ بَيْنَ القُرَى عَلَى الحِمَارِ، أَمَّا اليَوْمَ فَنَقْطَعُ المَسَافَةَ نَفْسَهَا بِالسَّيَّارَةِ فِي دَقَائِقَ.
conversation.en: My grandfather travelled between villages by donkey; today we cover the same distance by car in minutes.

conversation.q: هَلْ يَجِبُ أَنْ نَمْنَعَ السَّيَّارَاتِ فِي وَسَطِ المُدُنِ؟
conversation.qen: Should we ban cars from city centres?
conversation.model: صَحِيحٌ أَنَّ المَنْعَ يُقَلِّلُ التَّلَوُّثَ، غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ صَعْبٌ عَلَى كِبَارِ السِّنِّ وَذَوِي الإِعَاقَةِ.
conversation.en: It is true that a ban reduces pollution, but it is hard for older and disabled people.

conversation.qen: What is the hardest journey you have made?
conversation.model: أَصْعَبُ رِحْلَةٍ كَانَتْ عِنْدَمَا تَأَخَّرَ قِطَارُنَا ثَلَاثَ سَاعَاتٍ بِسَبَبِ الثَّلْجِ، فَوَصَلْنَا فِي مُنْتَصَفِ اللَّيْلِ.
conversation.en: The hardest journey was when our train was three hours late because of snow, so we arrived at midnight.

conversation.q: لَوْ صَمَّمْتَ وَسِيلَةَ مُوَاصَلَاتٍ جَدِيدَةً، كَيْفَ تَكُونُ؟
conversation.qen: If you designed a new means of transport, what would it be like?
conversation.model: لَوْ صَمَّمْتُ وَسِيلَةً جَدِيدَةً، لَجَعَلْتُهَا تَطِيرُ بِالطَّاقَةِ الشَّمْسِيَّةِ، فَتَكُونُ سَرِيعَةً وَنَظِيفَةً مَعًا.
conversation.en: If I designed a new one, I would make it fly on solar power, so it would be both fast and clean.

lessons.title: Everyday Journeys
lessons.intro: Paper 3 practice in breakout rooms: say how you travel and how long it takes, buy a ticket, ask for and give directions, and compare means of transport (asraʿu min …).

bank.title: Plan it, do it, tell it
Where shall we go — and how was it?

tasks.task: Suggest a place to go.
tasks.model: مَا رَأْيُكَ أَنْ نَذْهَبَ إِلَى الحَدِيقَةِ الكَبِيرَةِ؟
tasks.en: How about going to the big park?

tasks.task: Suggest a time and a meeting place.
tasks.model: نَلْتَقِي فِي السَّاعَةِ العَاشِرَةِ أَمَامَ المَكْتَبَةِ.
tasks.en: Let’s meet at ten in front of the library.

tasks.task: Say how you will travel.
tasks.model: نَذْهَبُ بِالحَافِلَةِ، لِأَنَّهَا رَخِيصَةٌ وَسَرِيعَةٌ.
tasks.en: We’ll go by bus, because it is cheap and quick.

tasks.task: Say what food you will bring.
tasks.model: سَأُحْضِرُ السَّنْدَوِيشَاتِ وَالفَوَاكِهَ وَالمَاءَ.
tasks.en: I’ll bring sandwiches, fruit and water.

tasks.task: Answer the unexpected question.
tasks.model: إِذَا كَانَ الجَوُّ مُمْطِرًا، نَذْهَبُ إِلَى المُتْحَفِ بَدَلًا مِنَ الحَدِيقَةِ.
tasks.en: If it’s raining, we’ll go to the museum instead of the park.

tasks.task: Ask what there is to do in the town.
tasks.model: مَرْحَبًا، مَاذَا يُمْكِنُ أَنْ نَفْعَلَ فِي المَدِينَةِ اليَوْمَ؟
tasks.en: Hello, what can we do in the town today?

tasks.task: Choose one and give a reason.
tasks.model: نُرِيدُ أَنْ نَزُورَ السُّوقَ القَدِيمَ، لِأَنَّ أُمِّي تُحِبُّ التَّسَوُّقَ.
tasks.en: We want to visit the old market, because my mum loves shopping.

tasks.task: ASK when it closes.
tasks.model: وَمَتَى يُغْلِقُ، مِنْ فَضْلِكَ؟
tasks.en: And when does it close, please?

tasks.examiner: فِي السَّادِسَةِ. وَهُنَاكَ مَطْعَمٌ مَشْهُورٌ قَرِيبٌ.
tasks.task: Ask the way to the restaurant.
tasks.model: رَائِعٌ! كَيْفَ نَصِلُ إِلَى المَطْعَمِ مِنْ هُنَا؟
tasks.en: Great! How do we get to the restaurant from here?

tasks.task: Answer the unexpected question.
tasks.model: سَنَبْقَى ثَلَاثَةَ أَيَّامٍ، حَتَّى يَوْمِ الثُّلَاثَاءِ.
tasks.en: We will stay three days, until Tuesday.

roleplays.title: Telling a friend about your day out
roleplays.you: a student who went on a day out
roleplays.examiner: a friend who stayed at home

tasks.task: Say where and with whom (past).
tasks.model: ذَهَبْتُ إِلَى الشَّاطِئِ مَعَ أُسْرَتِي وَأَوْلَادِ عَمِّي.
tasks.en: I went to the beach with my family and my cousins.

tasks.task: Describe two activities.
tasks.model: سَبَحْنَا فِي الصَّبَاحِ، ثُمَّ لَعِبْنَا كُرَةَ الطَّائِرَةِ عَلَى الرَّمْلِ.
tasks.en: We swam in the morning, then played volleyball on the sand.

tasks.task: Say what you ate and give an opinion.
tasks.model: أَكَلْنَا سَمَكًا مَشْوِيًّا فِي مَطْعَمٍ صَغِيرٍ، وَكَانَ أَلَذَّ سَمَكٍ أَكَلْتُهُ!
tasks.en: We ate grilled fish in a small restaurant — the tastiest fish I have ever eaten!

tasks.examiner: … أَنَا بَقِيتُ فِي البَيْتِ لِأَنِّي كُنْتُ مَرِيضًا.
tasks.task: Show sympathy and ASK how he feels now.
tasks.model: سَلَامَتُكَ! وَكَيْفَ تَشْعُرُ الآنَ؟
tasks.en: Get well soon! And how do you feel now?

tasks.task: Answer the unexpected question (future + invitation).
tasks.model: نَعَمْ، سَنَذْهَبُ فِي العُطْلَةِ القَادِمَةِ، فَهَلْ تَأْتِي مَعَنَا؟
tasks.en: Yes, we will go in the next holiday — will you come with us?

roleplays.title: How young people spend their weekends

tasks.examiner: كَيْفَ يَقْضِي الشَّبَابُ عُطْلَةَ نِهَايَةِ الأُسْبُوعِ اليَوْمَ؟
tasks.task: Describe and give an opinion.
tasks.model: يَقْضِي كَثِيرٌ مِنْهُمْ وَقْتَهُمْ أَمَامَ الشَّاشَاتِ، وَهٰذَا فِي رَأْيِي غَيْرُ صِحِّيٍّ.
tasks.en: Many of them spend their time in front of screens, which in my view is unhealthy.

tasks.task: Compare past and present.
tasks.model: كَانَ الشَّبَابُ يَخْرُجُونَ إِلَى الطَّبِيعَةِ أَكْثَرَ، أَمَّا اليَوْمَ فَيُفَضِّلُونَ المَرَاكِزَ التِّجَارِيَّةَ.
tasks.en: Young people used to go out into nature more; today they prefer shopping centres.

tasks.task: Tell a short story with a problem and a result.
tasks.model: ذَهَبْنَا إِلَى الجَبَلِ، وَفَجْأَةً بَدَأَ المَطَرُ، فَاخْتَبَأْنَا فِي كَهْفٍ صَغِيرٍ وَضَحِكْنَا كَثِيرًا.
tasks.en: We went to the mountain, and suddenly it started raining, so we hid in a small cave and laughed a lot.

tasks.examiner: يَقُولُ البَعْضُ إِنَّ النُّزُهَاتِ غَالِيَةٌ جِدًّا.
tasks.task: Concede and disagree.
tasks.model: صَحِيحٌ أَنَّ بَعْضَهَا غَالٍ، غَيْرَ أَنَّ المَشْيَ فِي الحَدِيقَةِ أَوْ عَلَى الشَّاطِئِ مَجَّانِيٌّ وَمُفِيدٌ.
tasks.en: It is true some are expensive, but walking in the park or on the beach is free and good for you.

tasks.examiner: لَوْ كُنْتَ تَسْتَطِيعُ أَنْ تَذْهَبَ إِلَى أَيِّ مَكَانٍ غَدًا، أَيْنَ تَذْهَبُ؟
tasks.task: Answer the unexpected question (a conditional).
tasks.model: لَوْ كُنْتُ أَسْتَطِيعُ، لَذَهَبْتُ إِلَى البَتْرَاءِ، لِأَنِّي أَحْلُمُ بِرُؤْيَتِهَا مُنْذُ سَنَوَاتٍ.
tasks.en: If I could, I would go to Petra, because I have dreamed of seeing it for years.

conversation.qen: What do you usually do on Saturdays?
conversation.model: يَوْمَ السَّبْتِ عَادَةً أَلْعَبُ كُرَةَ القَدَمِ، ثُمَّ أَزُورُ جَدَّتِي.
conversation.en: On Saturdays I usually play football, then visit my grandmother.

conversation.q: فِي أَيِّ سَاعَةٍ تَسْتَيْقِظُ فِي نِهَايَةِ الأُسْبُوعِ؟
conversation.qen: What time do you get up at the weekend?
conversation.model: أَسْتَيْقِظُ فِي السَّاعَةِ التَّاسِعَةِ، لِأَنِّي أُحِبُّ النَّوْمَ!
conversation.en: I get up at nine, because I love sleeping!

conversation.q: أَيْنَ تُحِبُّ أَنْ تَذْهَبَ مَعَ أُسْرَتِكَ؟
conversation.qen: Where do you like going with your family?
conversation.model: أُحِبُّ أَنْ أَذْهَبَ إِلَى الشَّاطِئِ مَعَ أُسْرَتِي.
conversation.en: I like going to the beach with my family.

conversation.qen: What do you eat on a day out?
conversation.model: نَأْكُلُ السَّنْدَوِيشَاتِ وَالفَوَاكِهَ، وَنَشْرَبُ العَصِيرَ.
conversation.en: We eat sandwiches and fruit, and drink juice.

conversation.q: أَيْنَ ذَهَبْتَ فِي نِهَايَةِ الأُسْبُوعِ المَاضِي؟
conversation.qen: Where did you go last weekend?
conversation.model: ذَهَبْتُ إِلَى السُّوقِ مَعَ أُمِّي، وَاشْتَرَيْتُ حِذَاءً جَدِيدًا.
conversation.en: I went to the market with my mum and bought new shoes.

conversation.qen: Describe a lovely day out you had.
conversation.model: فِي الرَّبِيعِ ذَهَبْنَا إِلَى مَزْرَعَةِ عَمِّي، وَقَطَفْنَا الفَرَاوِلَةَ، وَأَكَلْنَا الغَدَاءَ تَحْتَ الأَشْجَارِ.
conversation.en: In spring we went to my uncle’s farm, picked strawberries and ate lunch under the trees.

conversation.q: كَيْفَ تَذْهَبُونَ إِلَى النُّزْهَةِ؟ وَكَمْ تَسْتَغْرِقُ الرِّحْلَةُ؟
conversation.qen: How do you travel, and how long does it take?
conversation.model: نَذْهَبُ بِالسَّيَّارَةِ عَادَةً، وَتَسْتَغْرِقُ الرِّحْلَةُ سَاعَةً، فَنُغَنِّي فِي الطَّرِيقِ.
conversation.en: We usually go by car; it takes an hour, so we sing on the way.

conversation.q: هَلْ تُفَضِّلُ النُّزْهَةَ فِي المَدِينَةِ أَمْ فِي الطَّبِيعَةِ؟
conversation.qen: Do you prefer a day out in town or in nature?
conversation.model: أُفَضِّلُ الطَّبِيعَةَ، لِأَنَّ الهَوَاءَ أَنْظَفُ، وَالمَكَانَ أَهْدَأُ مِنَ المَدِينَةِ.
conversation.en: I prefer nature, because the air is cleaner and it is quieter than the town.

conversation.qen: Why are days out good for your health?
conversation.model: لِأَنَّنَا نَمْشِي وَنَتَنَفَّسُ هَوَاءً نَقِيًّا، وَنَنْسَى ضَغْطَ الدِّرَاسَةِ قَلِيلًا.
conversation.en: Because we walk and breathe fresh air, and forget the pressure of school for a while.

conversation.qen: What are your plans for next weekend?
conversation.model: سَأَزُورُ المُتْحَفَ الجَدِيدَ مَعَ أَصْدِقَائِي، ثُمَّ سَنَأْكُلُ البِيتْزَا فِي المَسَاءِ.
conversation.en: I will visit the new museum with my friends, then we will have pizza in the evening.

conversation.q: هَلْ يَقْضِي الشَّبَابُ وَقْتًا كَافِيًا مَعَ أُسَرِهِمْ؟
conversation.qen: Do young people spend enough time with their families?
conversation.model: لَا أَظُنُّ ذٰلِكَ، لِأَنَّ كُلَّ وَاحِدٍ مَشْغُولٌ بِهَاتِفِهِ، حَتَّى عِنْدَمَا يَجْلِسُونَ مَعًا.
conversation.en: I don’t think so, because everyone is busy with their phone, even when they sit together.

conversation.q: مَا الفَرْقُ بَيْنَ عُطْلَةِ نِهَايَةِ الأُسْبُوعِ عِنْدَكَ وَعِنْدَ وَالِدَيْكَ عِنْدَمَا كَانَا صَغِيرَيْنِ؟
conversation.qen: How do your weekends differ from your parents’ as children?
conversation.starter: كَانَ أَبِي يَقْضِي … أَمَّا أَنَا فَأَقْضِي …
conversation.model: كَانَ أَبِي يَقْضِي عُطْلَتَهُ فِي اللَّعِبِ فِي الحَيِّ، أَمَّا أَنَا فَأَقْضِي جُزْءًا كَبِيرًا مِنْهَا فِي الدُّرُوسِ الإِضَافِيَّةِ.
conversation.en: My father spent his weekends playing in the neighbourhood; I spend a big part of mine in extra lessons.

conversation.q: هَلْ يَجِبُ أَنْ تَكُونَ المَتَاحِفُ مَجَّانِيَّةً؟
conversation.qen: Should museums be free?
conversation.model: صَحِيحٌ أَنَّ المَتَاحِفَ تَحْتَاجُ إِلَى المَالِ، غَيْرَ أَنَّ الثَّقَافَةَ يَجِبُ أَنْ تَكُونَ لِلْجَمِيعِ، لَا لِلْأَغْنِيَاءِ فَقَطْ.
conversation.en: It is true museums need money, but culture should be for everyone, not just the rich.

conversation.qen: What is the most beautiful place you have visited?
conversation.model: أَجْمَلُ مَكَانٍ زُرْتُهُ هُوَ وَادِي رَمٍّ، لِأَنَّ الصَّحْرَاءَ هُنَاكَ حَمْرَاءُ، وَالنُّجُومَ فِي اللَّيْلِ لَا تُصَدَّقُ.
conversation.en: The most beautiful place I have visited is Wadi Rum, because the desert there is red and the stars at night are unbelievable.

conversation.q: لَوْ نَظَّمْتَ يَوْمًا مِثَالِيًّا لِصَفِّكَ، كَيْفَ يَكُونُ؟
conversation.qen: If you organised a perfect day for your class, what would it be like?
conversation.model: لَوْ نَظَّمْتُ يَوْمًا مِثَالِيًّا، لَبَدَأْنَا بِالمَشْيِ فِي الجَبَلِ، ثُمَّ تَغَدَّيْنَا عَلَى الشَّاطِئِ، وَخَتَمْنَا بِمُبَارَاةٍ.
conversation.en: If I organised a perfect day, we would start with a mountain walk, then have lunch on the beach and finish with a match.

lessons.title: Mixed Topic A: a Day Out
lessons.intro: Paper 3 practice in breakout rooms: plan and describe a day out, using everything from Topic A — times, food, transport, health — across past, present and future.

tasks.task: Say you want to book a room.
tasks.model: مَسَاءُ الخَيْرِ، أُرِيدُ أَنْ أَحْجِزَ غُرْفَةً، مِنْ فَضْلِكَ.
tasks.en: Good evening, I would like to book a room, please.

tasks.task: Say which room and for how many people.
tasks.model: غُرْفَةٌ مُزْدَوِجَةٌ لِشَخْصَيْنِ: أَنَا وَأَخِي.
tasks.en: A double room for two people: me and my brother.

tasks.task: Say how many nights and from when.
tasks.model: ثَلَاثَ لَيَالٍ، مِنْ يَوْمِ الخَمِيسِ إِلَى يَوْمِ الأَحَدِ.
tasks.en: Three nights, from Thursday to Sunday.

tasks.examiner: هَلْ تُرِيدُ غُرْفَةً تُطِلُّ عَلَى البَحْرِ؟
tasks.task: Answer and give a reason.
tasks.model: نَعَمْ، مِنْ فَضْلِكَ، لِأَنَّ المَنْظَرَ جَمِيلٌ.
tasks.en: Yes please, because the view is beautiful.

tasks.task: Answer the unexpected question.
tasks.model: سَأَصِلُ فِي السَّاعَةِ الخَامِسَةِ مَسَاءً تَقْرِيبًا.
tasks.en: I will arrive at about five in the evening.

tasks.task: Explain the problem with your room.
tasks.help: نَعَمْ، المُكَيِّفُ فِي غُرْفَتِي لَا يَعْمَلُ …
tasks.model: نَعَمْ، المُكَيِّفُ فِي غُرْفَتِي لَا يَعْمَلُ، وَالجَوُّ حَارٌّ جِدًّا.
tasks.en: Yes, the air conditioning in my room doesn’t work, and it is very hot.

tasks.task: Give the room number and floor.
tasks.model: غُرْفَةٌ رَقْمُ مِئَتَيْنِ وَخَمْسَةٍ، فِي الطَّابِقِ الثَّانِي.
tasks.en: Room 205, on the second floor.

tasks.task: Ask politely for another room tonight.
tasks.model: هَلْ يُمْكِنُ أَنْ تُعْطِيَنِي غُرْفَةً أُخْرَى اللَّيْلَةَ؟
tasks.en: Could you give me another room tonight?

tasks.examiner: طَبْعًا. عِنْدَنَا غُرْفَةٌ فِي الطَّابِقِ الخَامِسِ.
tasks.task: Thank him and ASK about breakfast time.
tasks.model: شُكْرًا جَزِيلًا. وَمَتَى يَبْدَأُ الفُطُورُ فِي الصَّبَاحِ؟
tasks.en: Thank you very much. And when does breakfast start?

tasks.task: Answer the unexpected question (past + opinion).
tasks.model: زُرْتُ القَلْعَةَ وَالسُّوقَ القَدِيمَ، وَكَانَ كُلُّ شَيْءٍ رَائِعًا.
tasks.en: I visited the castle and the old market, and everything was wonderful.

tasks.task: Say where, with whom and how long.
tasks.model: قَضَيْتُ أُسْبُوعًا فِي إِسْطَنْبُولَ مَعَ أُسْرَتِي.
tasks.en: I spent a week in Istanbul with my family.

tasks.task: Say how you travelled and where you stayed.
tasks.model: سَافَرْنَا بِالطَّائِرَةِ، وَنَزَلْنَا فِي فُنْدُقٍ صَغِيرٍ قَرِيبٍ مِنَ البَحْرِ.
tasks.en: We flew, and stayed in a small hotel near the sea.

tasks.task: Describe a sight with a superlative.
tasks.model: أَجْمَلُ شَيْءٍ كَانَ المَسْجِدَ الأَزْرَقَ، لِأَنَّهُ ضَخْمٌ وَمُزَيَّنٌ بِأَلْوَانٍ رَائِعَةٍ.
tasks.en: The most beautiful thing was the Blue Mosque, because it is huge and decorated in wonderful colours.

tasks.task: Describe a small problem and the result.
tasks.model: نَعَمْ، ضَاعَتْ حَقِيبَةُ أُخْتِي فِي المَطَارِ، فَانْتَظَرْنَا سَاعَتَيْنِ حَتَّى وَجَدُوهَا.
tasks.en: Yes, my sister’s bag got lost at the airport, so we waited two hours until they found it.

tasks.task: Answer the unexpected question (advice + idhā).
tasks.model: نَعَمْ، وَإِذَا ذَهَبَ فِي الرَّبِيعِ، فَيَجِبُ أَنْ يَرْكَبَ القَارِبَ فِي البُوسْفُورِ.
tasks.en: Yes, and if he goes in spring, he must take a boat on the Bosphorus.

tasks.examiner: لِمَاذَا يُحِبُّ النَّاسُ السَّفَرَ فِي رَأْيِكَ؟
tasks.task: Give two reasons.
tasks.model: لِأَنَّهُ يُبْعِدُنَا عَنْ ضَغْطِ الحَيَاةِ اليَوْمِيَّةِ، وَلِأَنَّهُ يُعَرِّفُنَا بِثَقَافَاتٍ جَدِيدَةٍ.
tasks.en: Because it takes us away from daily stress, and because it introduces us to new cultures.

tasks.task: Give a disadvantage with an example.
tasks.model: نَعَمْ، مِثْلًا تَزْدَحِمُ المُدُنُ القَدِيمَةُ بِالسُّيَّاحِ، فَيَرْتَفِعُ سِعْرُ السَّكَنِ عَلَى أَهْلِهَا.
tasks.en: Yes — for example old cities get crowded with tourists, so housing prices rise for the locals.

tasks.examiner: كَيْفَ تَغَيَّرَ السَّفَرُ مُنْذُ أَيَّامِ أَجْدَادِنَا؟
tasks.task: Compare past and present.
tasks.model: كَانَ السَّفَرُ صَعْبًا وَغَالِيًا، أَمَّا اليَوْمَ فَنَحْجِزُ الرِّحْلَةَ وَالفُنْدُقَ بِالهَاتِفِ فِي دَقَائِقَ.
tasks.en: Travel used to be hard and expensive; today we book the flight and hotel on our phone in minutes.

tasks.examiner: هَلْ يَجِبُ أَنْ نُقَلِّلَ السَّفَرَ بِالطَّائِرَةِ؟
tasks.task: Concede and give your view.
tasks.model: صَحِيحٌ أَنَّ الطَّائِرَاتِ تُلَوِّثُ البِيئَةَ، غَيْرَ أَنَّنَا نَسْتَطِيعُ أَنْ نُسَافِرَ أَقَلَّ وَنَبْقَى مُدَّةً أَطْوَلَ.
tasks.en: It is true that planes pollute, but we can travel less often and stay longer.

tasks.examiner: لَوْ رَبِحْتَ رِحْلَةً مَجَّانِيَّةً، أَيْنَ تَذْهَبُ؟
tasks.task: Answer the unexpected question (law … la-).
tasks.model: لَوْ رَبِحْتُ رِحْلَةً مَجَّانِيَّةً، لَذَهَبْتُ إِلَى المَغْرِبِ، لِأَزُورَ فَاسَ وَأَتَعَلَّمَ صِنَاعَةَ الفَخَّارِ.
tasks.en: If I won a free trip, I would go to Morocco to visit Fez and learn pottery.

conversation.qen: Where did you travel last summer?
conversation.model: سَافَرْتُ إِلَى مِصْرَ مَعَ أُسْرَتِي.
conversation.en: I travelled to Egypt with my family.

conversation.qen: How did you travel?
conversation.model: سَافَرْنَا بِالطَّائِرَةِ، وَاسْتَغْرَقَتِ الرِّحْلَةُ خَمْسَ سَاعَاتٍ.
conversation.en: We flew, and the flight took five hours.

conversation.qen: Where did you stay?
conversation.model: نَزَلْنَا فِي فُنْدُقٍ كَبِيرٍ قَرِيبٍ مِنَ النِّيلِ.
conversation.en: We stayed in a big hotel near the Nile.

conversation.qen: What did you visit?
conversation.model: زُرْنَا الأَهْرَامَ وَالمُتْحَفَ المِصْرِيَّ.
conversation.en: We visited the pyramids and the Egyptian Museum.

conversation.qen: Do you like travelling?
conversation.model: نَعَمْ، أُحِبُّ السَّفَرَ كَثِيرًا، لِأَنِّي أَرَى أَمَاكِنَ جَدِيدَةً.
conversation.en: Yes, I love travelling, because I see new places.

conversation.qen: Describe the most beautiful city you have visited.
conversation.model: أَجْمَلُ مَدِينَةٍ زُرْتُهَا هِيَ غَرْنَاطَةُ؛ فِيهَا قَصْرُ الحَمْرَاءِ وَحَدَائِقُ رَائِعَةٌ وَشَوَارِعُ ضَيِّقَةٌ.
conversation.en: The most beautiful city I have visited is Granada; it has the Alhambra, wonderful gardens and narrow streets.

conversation.q: هَلْ تُفَضِّلُ عُطْلَةً عَلَى الشَّاطِئِ أَمْ فِي مَدِينَةٍ تَارِيخِيَّةٍ؟
conversation.qen: Beach holiday or historic city?
conversation.model: أُفَضِّلُ المَدِينَةَ التَّارِيخِيَّةَ، لِأَنِّي أُحِبُّ التَّارِيخَ، وَالشَّاطِئُ مُمِلٌّ بَعْدَ يَوْمَيْنِ.
conversation.en: I prefer a historic city, because I love history, and the beach is boring after two days.

conversation.q: مَا الَّذِي تَأْخُذُهُ مَعَكَ دَائِمًا فِي السَّفَرِ؟
conversation.qen: What do you always take when travelling?
conversation.model: آخُذُ دَائِمًا كِتَابًا وَشَاحِنَ الهَاتِفِ، لِأَنَّ الرِّحْلَاتِ الطَّوِيلَةَ مُمِلَّةٌ.
conversation.en: I always take a book and a phone charger, because long journeys are boring.

conversation.q: هَلْ حَدَثَتْ لَكَ مُشْكِلَةٌ فِي السَّفَرِ؟
conversation.qen: Have you had a problem while travelling?
conversation.model: نَعَمْ، مَرَّةً تَأَخَّرَتْ طَائِرَتُنَا سِتَّ سَاعَاتٍ، فَنِمْنَا عَلَى الكَرَاسِي فِي المَطَارِ.
conversation.en: Yes, once our plane was six hours late, so we slept on the chairs at the airport.

conversation.qen: Where will you spend your next holiday?
conversation.model: إِذَا نَجَحْتُ فِي الامْتِحَانَاتِ، سَنَذْهَبُ إِلَى الأُرْدُنِّ لِنَزُورَ البَتْرَاءَ.
conversation.en: If I pass my exams, we will go to Jordan to visit Petra.

conversation.qen: Is travel the best way to learn?
conversation.model: أَعْتَقِدُ أَنَّهُ مِنْ أَفْضَلِ الطُّرُقِ، لِأَنَّنَا نَتَعَلَّمُ اللُّغَةَ وَالتَّارِيخَ مِنَ النَّاسِ مُبَاشَرَةً، لَا مِنَ الكُتُبِ فَقَطْ.
conversation.en: I think it is one of the best ways, because we learn language and history directly from people, not only from books.

conversation.q: كَيْفَ تُؤَثِّرُ السِّيَاحَةُ فِي البِلَادِ الفَقِيرَةِ؟
conversation.qen: How does tourism affect poorer countries?
conversation.model: مِنْ نَاحِيَةٍ تُوَفِّرُ فُرَصَ عَمَلٍ، وَمِنْ نَاحِيَةٍ أُخْرَى قَدْ تُضِرُّ بِالبِيئَةِ وَالتَّقَالِيدِ المَحَلِّيَّةِ.
conversation.en: On one hand it creates jobs; on the other it may harm the environment and local traditions.

conversation.q: هَلِ السُّيَّاحُ يَحْتَرِمُونَ ثَقَافَةَ البِلَادِ دَائِمًا؟
conversation.qen: Do tourists always respect local culture?
conversation.model: لَيْسَ دَائِمًا؛ فَبَعْضُهُمْ يَلْبَسُونَ مَلَابِسَ غَيْرَ مُنَاسِبَةٍ فِي الأَمَاكِنِ الدِّينِيَّةِ، لِأَنَّهُمْ لَمْ يَقْرَؤُوا عَنْهَا قَبْلَ السَّفَرِ.
conversation.en: Not always; some wear inappropriate clothes in religious places because they didn’t read about them before travelling.

conversation.q: هَلِ السَّفَرُ الافْتِرَاضِيُّ يُغْنِي عَنِ السَّفَرِ الحَقِيقِيِّ؟
conversation.qen: Can virtual travel replace real travel?
conversation.model: صَحِيحٌ أَنَّهُ رَخِيصٌ وَمُفِيدٌ لِلْبِيئَةِ، غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ لَا يُعْطِينَا رَائِحَةَ الأَسْوَاقِ وَلَا طَعْمَ الأَكْلِ.
conversation.en: It is true it is cheap and good for the environment, but it can’t give us the smell of the markets or the taste of the food.

conversation.q: لَوْ عِشْتَ سَنَةً فِي بَلَدٍ آخَرَ، أَيَّ بَلَدٍ تَخْتَارُ؟
conversation.qen: If you lived a year abroad, which country would you choose?
conversation.model: لَوْ عِشْتُ سَنَةً فِي بَلَدٍ آخَرَ، لَاخْتَرْتُ اليَابَانَ، لِأَنَّ ثَقَافَتَهَا مُخْتَلِفَةٌ تَمَامًا عَنْ ثَقَافَتِنَا.
conversation.en: If I lived a year abroad, I would choose Japan, because its culture is completely different from ours.

lessons.title: Travel and Tourism
lessons.intro: Paper 3 practice in breakout rooms: book a hotel room, talk about a past holiday, describe sights and problems, and imagine dream trips with idhā and law.

bank.title: Topic A in twelve structures
bank.arabic: المِحْوَرُ الأَوَّلُ فِي اثْنَتَيْ عَشْرَةَ بِنْيَةً

roleplays.title: Your first evening with a host family

tasks.examiner: أَهْلًا وَسَهْلًا! فِي أَيِّ سَاعَةٍ تَسْتَيْقِظُ عَادَةً؟
tasks.task: Say when you usually get up.
tasks.model: أَسْتَيْقِظُ عَادَةً فِي السَّاعَةِ السَّادِسَةِ وَالنِّصْفِ.
tasks.en: I usually get up at half past six.

tasks.task: Say what you eat for breakfast.
tasks.model: آكُلُ الخُبْزَ مَعَ الجُبْنِ، وَأَشْرَبُ الشَّايَ بِالحَلِيبِ.
tasks.en: I eat bread with cheese and drink tea with milk.

tasks.task: Say what you don’t eat and why.
tasks.model: لَا آكُلُ السَّمَكَ، لِأَنِّي لَا أُحِبُّ طَعْمَهُ.
tasks.en: I don’t eat fish, because I don’t like the taste.

tasks.task: Describe your journey (past).
tasks.model: سَافَرْتُ بِالطَّائِرَةِ، وَاسْتَغْرَقَتِ الرِّحْلَةُ خَمْسَ سَاعَاتٍ، لٰكِنَّهَا كَانَتْ مُرِيحَةً.
tasks.en: I flew, and the journey took five hours, but it was comfortable.

tasks.task: Answer the unexpected question.
tasks.model: أُرِيدُ أَنْ أَزُورَ وَسَطَ المَدِينَةِ وَالسُّوقَ القَدِيمَ.
tasks.en: I would like to visit the city centre and the old market.

roleplays.title: Ordering for a friend who is unwell

tasks.task: Ask for a table and say for how many.
tasks.model: طَاوِلَةٌ لِشَخْصَيْنِ، مِنْ فَضْلِكَ، بِجَانِبِ النَّافِذَةِ.
tasks.en: A table for two, please, by the window.

tasks.task: Order a main dish and a drink.
tasks.model: أُرِيدُ دَجَاجًا مَشْوِيًّا مَعَ الأُرْزِ، وَعَصِيرَ بُرْتُقَالٍ.
tasks.en: I would like grilled chicken with rice, and an orange juice.

tasks.task: Explain your friend has a stomach ache and ASK for something light.
tasks.model: صَدِيقِي يُؤْلِمُهُ بَطْنُهُ، فَهَلْ عِنْدَكُمْ شُورْبَةٌ خَفِيفَةٌ؟
tasks.en: My friend has a stomach ache, so do you have a light soup?

tasks.examiner: عِنْدَنَا شُورْبَةُ خُضَارٍ. هَلْ تُرِيدُ حَلْوَى بَعْدَ ذٰلِكَ؟
tasks.task: Decline politely and give a reason.
tasks.model: لَا، شُكْرًا، لِأَنِّي أُحَاوِلُ أَنْ آكُلَ سُكَّرًا أَقَلَّ.
tasks.en: No thank you, because I am trying to eat less sugar.

tasks.task: Answer the unexpected question (past + opinion).
tasks.model: نَعَمْ، فِي الشَّهْرِ المَاضِي، وَكَانَ الأَكْلُ لَذِيذًا جِدًّا.
tasks.en: Yes, last month, and the food was delicious.

tasks.task: Describe two symptoms and how long.
tasks.model: عِنْدِي صُدَاعٌ وَحَرَارَةٌ مُنْذُ أَمْسِ.
tasks.en: I have had a headache and a temperature since yesterday.

tasks.task: Explain a likely cause (past).
tasks.model: قَضَيْتُ اليَوْمَ كُلَّهُ عَلَى الشَّاطِئِ تَحْتَ الشَّمْسِ، وَلَمْ أَشْرَبْ مَاءً كَافِيًا.
tasks.en: I spent the whole day on the beach in the sun and didn’t drink enough water.

tasks.examiner: خُذْ حَبَّةً كُلَّ سِتِّ سَاعَاتٍ، وَاشْرَبْ مَاءً كَثِيرًا.
tasks.task: Repeat the instructions to check.
tasks.model: إِذَنْ، حَبَّةً كُلَّ سِتِّ سَاعَاتٍ، وَأَشْرَبُ مَاءً كَثِيرًا. هَلْ آخُذُهَا بَعْدَ الأَكْلِ؟
tasks.en: So, one tablet every six hours, and I drink lots of water. Do I take it after food?

tasks.examiner: نَعَمْ. وَأَنْصَحُكَ بِأَلَّا تَخْرُجَ فِي الظُّهْرِ.
tasks.task: Say how you will change your plans (future).
tasks.model: حَسَنًا، سَأَبْقَى فِي الفُنْدُقِ فِي الظُّهْرِ، وَسَأَزُورُ المُتْحَفَ بَدَلًا مِنَ الشَّاطِئِ.
tasks.en: OK, I will stay in the hotel at midday, and I’ll visit the museum instead of the beach.

tasks.examiner: مِنْ أَيْنَ أَنْتَ؟ وَهَلْ تُعْجِبُكَ مَدِينَتُنَا؟
tasks.task: Answer the unexpected question (opinion + comparison).
tasks.model: أَنَا مِنْ مَانْشِسْتَرَ، وَمَدِينَتُكُمْ أَجْمَلُ وَأَدْفَأُ مِنْ مَدِينَتِي بِكَثِيرٍ!
tasks.en: I am from Manchester, and your city is much prettier and warmer than mine!

tasks.examiner: هَلْ يَعِيشُ الشَّبَابُ اليَوْمَ حَيَاةً صِحِّيَّةً؟
tasks.task: Give your view with two reasons.
tasks.model: لَا أَظُنُّ ذٰلِكَ، لِأَنَّهُمْ يَنَامُونَ قَلِيلًا، وَلِأَنَّهُمْ يَأْكُلُونَ الوَجَبَاتِ السَّرِيعَةَ كَثِيرًا.
tasks.en: I don’t think so, because they sleep little and eat fast food often.

tasks.task: Compare past and present.
tasks.model: كَانَ النَّاسُ يَمْشُونَ أَكْثَرَ وَيَطْبُخُونَ فِي البَيْتِ، أَمَّا اليَوْمَ فَنَرْكَبُ السَّيَّارَاتِ وَنَطْلُبُ الأَكْلَ بِالهَاتِفِ.
tasks.en: People used to walk more and cook at home; today we drive and order food by phone.

tasks.task: Give a personal example of a change you made (past).
tasks.model: كُنْتُ أَذْهَبُ إِلَى المَدْرَسَةِ بِالسَّيَّارَةِ، فَقَرَّرْتُ أَنْ أَمْشِيَ، وَالآنَ أَشْعُرُ بِنَشَاطٍ أَكْبَرَ.
tasks.en: I used to go to school by car, so I decided to walk, and now I feel more energetic.

tasks.examiner: لٰكِنَّ التِّكْنُولُوجْيَا تُسَاعِدُنَا أَيْضًا، أَلَيْسَ كَذٰلِكَ؟
tasks.task: Concede and keep your view.
tasks.model: صَحِيحٌ أَنَّ التَّطْبِيقَاتِ تُذَكِّرُنَا بِشُرْبِ المَاءِ، غَيْرَ أَنَّهَا لَا تَمْشِي عَنَّا!
tasks.en: It is true that apps remind us to drink water, but they can’t walk for us!

tasks.examiner: لَوْ كَانَ لَكَ أَنْ تُغَيِّرَ شَيْئًا وَاحِدًا فِي مَدِينَتِكَ، فَمَاذَا يَكُونُ؟
tasks.task: Answer the unexpected question (law … la-).
tasks.model: لَوْ كَانَ لِي ذٰلِكَ، لَبَنَيْتُ مَلَاعِبَ مَجَّانِيَّةً قُرْبَ كُلِّ مَدْرَسَةٍ، وَلَمَنَعْتُ السَّيَّارَاتِ أَمَامَهَا صَبَاحًا.
tasks.en: If I could, I would build free sports pitches near every school, and ban cars outside them in the morning.

conversation.qen: Describe a normal day in your life.
conversation.model: أَسْتَيْقِظُ فِي السَّابِعَةِ، ثُمَّ أَذْهَبُ إِلَى المَدْرَسَةِ، وَأَرْجِعُ فِي الثَّالِثَةِ.
conversation.en: I get up at seven, then go to school, and come back at three.

conversation.qen: What is your favourite food?
conversation.model: طَعَامِي المُفَضَّلُ هُوَ المَقْلُوبَةُ الَّتِي تَطْبُخُهَا جَدَّتِي.
conversation.en: My favourite food is the maqluba my grandmother cooks.

conversation.qen: How often do you exercise?
conversation.model: أُمَارِسُ الرِّيَاضَةَ ثَلَاثَ مَرَّاتٍ فِي الأُسْبُوعِ.
conversation.en: I exercise three times a week.

conversation.qen: How do you get to school?
conversation.model: أَذْهَبُ بِالحَافِلَةِ، وَتَسْتَغْرِقُ الرِّحْلَةُ عِشْرِينَ دَقِيقَةً.
conversation.en: I go by bus, and the journey takes twenty minutes.

conversation.qen: Where did you spend your last holiday?
conversation.model: قَضَيْتُ عُطْلَتِي فِي بَيْتِ جَدِّي فِي القَرْيَةِ.
conversation.en: I spent my holiday at my grandfather’s house in the village.

conversation.q: مَاذَا فَعَلْتَ فِي نِهَايَةِ الأُسْبُوعِ المَاضِي؟
conversation.qen: What did you do last weekend?
conversation.model: يَوْمَ السَّبْتِ لَعِبْتُ مُبَارَاةً، وَيَوْمَ الأَحَدِ تَغَدَّيْنَا فِي مَطْعَمٍ لُبْنَانِيٍّ، وَكَانَ الأَكْلُ لَذِيذًا جِدًّا.
conversation.en: On Saturday I played a match, and on Sunday we had lunch in a Lebanese restaurant; the food was delicious.

conversation.qen: Is your diet healthy? Why?
conversation.model: إِلَى حَدٍّ مَا، لِأَنِّي آكُلُ الخُضَارَ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ، لٰكِنِّي أَشْرَبُ المَشْرُوبَاتِ الغَازِيَّةَ أَحْيَانًا.
conversation.en: To some extent, because I eat vegetables every day, but I sometimes drink fizzy drinks.

conversation.qen: What advice for a student who is always tired?
conversation.model: يَجِبُ أَنْ يَنَامَ ثَمَانِيَ سَاعَاتٍ، وَأَلَّا يَسْتَعْمِلَ الهَاتِفَ قَبْلَ النَّوْمِ.
conversation.en: He must sleep eight hours and not use his phone before bed.

conversation.qen: Compare the bus and the bike.
conversation.model: الحَافِلَةُ أَسْرَعُ مِنَ الدَّرَّاجَةِ فِي المَطَرِ، لٰكِنَّ الدَّرَّاجَةَ أَرْخَصُ وَأَفْضَلُ لِلصِّحَّةِ.
conversation.en: The bus is faster than the bike in the rain, but the bike is cheaper and healthier.

conversation.qen: What are your plans for next summer?
conversation.model: إِذَا نَجَحْتُ فِي الامْتِحَانَاتِ، سَنُسَافِرُ إِلَى المَغْرِبِ، وَسَأَتَعَلَّمُ رُكُوبَ الأَمْوَاجِ.
conversation.en: If I pass my exams, we will travel to Morocco, and I will learn to surf.

conversation.q: هَلْ تَغَيَّرَ رُوتِينُ الشَّبَابِ اليَوْمِيُّ عَنِ المَاضِي؟
conversation.qen: Has young people’s routine changed from the past?
conversation.model: كَانَ الشَّبَابُ يَنَامُونَ مُبَكِّرًا وَيَلْعَبُونَ فِي الخَارِجِ، أَمَّا اليَوْمَ فَيَسْهَرُونَ عَلَى الشَّاشَاتِ حَتَّى مُنْتَصَفِ اللَّيْلِ.
conversation.en: Young people used to sleep early and play outside; today they stay up on screens until midnight.

conversation.q: مَا أَهَمُّ شَيْءٍ لِحَيَاةٍ صِحِّيَّةٍ فِي رَأْيِكَ؟
conversation.qen: What matters most for a healthy life?
conversation.model: أَعْتَقِدُ أَنَّ أَهَمَّ شَيْءٍ هُوَ التَّوَازُنُ: نَوْمٌ كَافٍ، وَأَكْلٌ مُتَنَوِّعٌ، وَحَرَكَةٌ يَوْمِيَّةٌ، لِأَنَّ الجِسْمَ يَحْتَاجُ إِلَيْهَا كُلِّهَا.
conversation.en: I think the most important thing is balance: enough sleep, varied food and daily movement, because the body needs them all.

conversation.qen: Is travel a necessity or a luxury?
conversation.model: صَحِيحٌ أَنَّهُ غَالٍ أَحْيَانًا، غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ يُعَلِّمُنَا الصَّبْرَ وَاحْتِرَامَ الآخَرِينَ، وَهٰذَا ضَرُورِيٌّ لِكُلِّ إِنْسَانٍ.
conversation.en: It is true it is sometimes expensive, but it teaches us patience and respect for others, which everyone needs.

conversation.q: مَا الدَّرْسُ الَّذِي تَعَلَّمْتَهُ مِنْ هٰذَا المِحْوَرِ؟
conversation.qen: What lesson have you learned from this topic?
conversation.model: تَعَلَّمْتُ أَنَّ عَادَاتِنَا الصَّغِيرَةَ تَصْنَعُ صِحَّتَنَا، وَلِذٰلِكَ سَأَمْشِي أَكْثَرَ وَأَنَامُ مُبَكِّرًا.
conversation.en: I have learned that our small habits make our health, so I will walk more and sleep earlier.

conversation.q: لَوْ كَتَبْتَ يَوْمًا مِثَالِيًّا لِنَفْسِكَ، كَيْفَ يَكُونُ؟
conversation.qen: If you wrote yourself a perfect day, what would it be like?
conversation.model: لَوْ كَتَبْتُ يَوْمًا مِثَالِيًّا، لَبَدَأْتُهُ بِالسِّبَاحَةِ، ثُمَّ لَتَغَدَّيْتُ مَعَ أُسْرَتِي فِي مَطْعَمٍ عَلَى البَحْرِ، وَلَخَتَمْتُهُ بِكِتَابٍ جَيِّدٍ.
conversation.en: If I wrote a perfect day, I would start it with a swim, then have lunch with my family by the sea, and end it with a good book.
